chapters.title: Chapter 2651 Clearing the 46th Floor
paragraphs: "You want me to join your squad...?" Mei Xiaoyun muttered in a somewhat dazed voice.
"Is it really that surprising?" Yuan smiled at her reaction. "In this entire world, I trust you and your mother the most, after all."
"With that being said... since you've refused hundreds of invites, you're probably not ready to join any squad yet."
"Then why did you even ask?" Mei Xiaoyun frowned slightly.
"I wanted to let you know that option was on the table," Yuan replied.
"Anyways, I'll see you later."
Yuan turned around and continued walking.
However, after taking just a few steps, Mei Xiaoyun's voice resounded from behind, "I'll join your squad."
Yuan's movements froze at her words.
He turned around with a smile and asked, "Can I ask why?"
"I just feel like it," she said with a casual shrug, seemingly unwilling to answer.
"Good enough," Yuan said, not going to question further.
"What's the name of our squad? And how many members do we have?"
"Right now, you're the only member besides me. As for the name... I haven't thought of one yet."
"So... you haven't even created the squad yet?"
"Nope."
Mei Xiaoyun was speechless.
"I'll let you know once I create it. See ya."
Yuan disappeared into the training hall the next moment.
"Why did I join...?" Mei Xiaoyun mumbled in a low voice, looking like she was puzzled by her own decision.
"Forget it. It's not like I have plans to join another squad."
Mei Xiaoyun shook her head and returned to her living quarters shortly after.
Meanwhile, Yuan entered Simulated Combat and began his fight against the entity on the 46th floor.
Just like before, Yuan's Eternal Essence was just enough to overwhelm the entity's.
"I can see it! I can see its movements properly now!" Yuan clenched his fists in excitement when the entity escaped into the void.
"Not this time, you bastard!"
Now that Yuan could follow the entity's movements through the void, he was finally able to react in time and block its attacks.

After having its attack stopped, the entity immediately tried to retreat back into the void. Unfortunately for it, Yuan could do more than merely track its movements now, as he could also strike it while it was still inside the void.
An immense amount of Eternal Essence surged through Yuan's arm as he swung it through the air like a blade.
The next moment, the entity was violently forced out of the void after being struck by his attack, screaming in pain.
"Hahaha! That's more like it!"

Although the attack wasn't powerful enough to defeat the entity in a single strike, Yuan actually preferred it that way. After being killed by it hundreds of times, he had accumulated plenty of frustration, and now he finally had the opportunity to vent it.
After several minutes and hundreds of exchanges, Yuan finally defeated the entity, clearing the 46th floor.

However, a single victory wasn't enough to satisfy him, and he immediately challenged the 46th floor again, defeating the entity over and over—hundreds of times—until he had finally vented all of his pent-up frustration.
"Now I just need to clear it at Gaia's Sanctum," Yuan mumbled to himself as he left the training hall.

Although Simulated Combat functioned identically to Endless Assault, the two were completely separate systems. As a result, clearing the 46th floor here had no effect on his progress in Gaia's Sanctum.
In other words, Yuan would still need to defeat the 46th floor in Gaia's Sanctum before he could advance to the 47th floor and beyond.
As much as he wanted to visit Gaia's Sanctum immediately, there were only two weeks left before the drill, so he decided to wait until afterward.
Shortly after Yuan left, a commotion broke out in the training hall when the soldiers noticed something different.
"S-Someone just cleared the 46th floor for Simulated Combat!"
"What?! Who?! Who was it?!"
Soldiers swiftly gathered at the ranking board.
[Simulated Combat Rankings]
[1. ???: 46th floor(21seconds)]
[2. ???: 45th floor(84 hours, 42 minutes, 11 seconds)]
"A hidden name? What a pity.
"A-Am I seeing things, or does that say 21 seconds?"
"It definitely says 21 seconds, but there's no way anyone could clear the 46th floor in such a short time, especially when the second rank took several days to clear the 45th floor..."
"So you're saying that it's a bug? But the system has never bugged out before."
"When did the ranking change?"
"I noticed it a few minutes ago, and it wasn't there half an hour ago."
"Then that person must still be inside, right? Let's wait and see who comes out."
Thus, the soldiers began waiting for someone who had already left.
Since the rankings don't update until the participant exits the waiting room, Yuan's name did not appear after his first clear, as he had remained inside to challenge the same stage repeatedly.
"By the way, who's in second place? Their name is also hidden."
"This is just a rumor, but I heard it's the Supreme General—the current one."
"Speaking of the Supreme General, he's retiring soon, right?"
"That's what I heard, too."
"There's a reason the two Generals are going at each other's necks right now."

It didn't take long for news of the updated ranking to spread throughout the military, with countless soldiers speculating about the identity of this mysterious individual. Of course, nobody guessed it correctly.
"It can't be him, right...?" Mei Feng muttered to herself after hearing this news.
Even with Yuan's recent achievement, for him to clear the 46th floor in 21 seconds was too far-fetched for her to believe.
Meanwhile, after leaving the training hall, Yuan made his way to create his own squad.
"Hello, is this where I create a squad?"
"Yes. Do you already have four members?"
"No, not yet."
"Then for now, you can only register the squad's name. To officially establish the squad, you'll need at least four members in total. Have you decided on a name yet?"
Yuan nodded and said with a smile, "My squad will be named Nine Heavens."

chapters.title: Chapter 2652 Squad Name
paragraphs: "Nine Heavens, correct? I have registered it in the system, Sergeant Yuan. Once you acquire three other members, you'll officially be recognized as a squad."
"Do I have to bring them here with me?" Yuan then asked.
"No, they just need to join the squad. Although it's not an official squad, soldiers can still apply to join it."
"I understand."
Yuan left the place shortly after and went to notify Mei Xiaoyun that he'd created the squad.
"The name of the squad is Nine Heavens."
Mei Xiaoyun raised an eyebrow at the name and inquired, "Is there a specific reason why there are nine heavens? Do you intend to have nine members?"
"No, it's just the name of my world," he said with a smile.
"Now that you mention it..." Mei Xiaoyun recalled hearing such a name before. "Anyways, I'll put in my request whenever I have time, unless you really need me to do it right now."
"You can take your time, since I still need to find two other members," he said. "Speaking of time... what do you usually do these days?"
"Training. Although I can already use Void Control, I want to improve my mastery and confidence before doing missions outside the city."
"I'd love to help you, but Void Control isn't something that can really be taught—" Yuan suddenly paused, a pondering expression appearing on his face.
"Hey, you wanna try something? It could help speed up your training."
Mei Xiaoyun looked at him with a suspicious gaze.
"What is it?"
"It's hard to explain, so just follow me."
Yuan proceeded to lead Mei Xiaoyun to his living quarters.
"Are we going to train here...? At your home?"
Yuan nodded, "It's not something I want people to see, after all."
The suspicious look on Mei Xiaoyung's face became even more evident, but she didn't say anything and entered his home shortly after.
Once inside, Yuan extended his hand and said, "I am going to bring you into the void with me. See if being surrounded by the void helps with your training."
"Huh? What do you mean—"
Before Mei Xiaoyun could even finish her sentence, Yuan grabbed her hand and used Void Manipulation, dragging her into the void with him.
Once they were inside the void, Yuan manipulated the void around both of them, keeping Mei Xiaoyun safe. However, doing this consumed Yuan's stamina at several times the rate it normally would.
"T-This is...?!" Mei Xiaoyun stared into the pitch-black void with widened eyes and a dazed expression.

Although this wasn't her first time entering the void, as she could also use Void Manipulation, she had never remained inside for more than a split second—unlike Yuan, who seemed perfectly capable of lingering there.

However, it wasn't that Mei Xiaoyun was incapable of remaining inside the void. Rather, when she had been taught Void Manipulation during boot camp, there was one warning the instructors had repeatedly drilled into everyone's minds.
"Go in and get out. Never linger in the void, or it could destroy both your body and soul."
That warning had been emphasized so often that it had practically become instinct.
Mei Xiaoyun turned to look at Yuan, who looked unfathomably tranquil.
"Don't look at me," Yuan suddenly said to her. "You won't learn anything by staring at my face. Look at the void and study it."
Mei Xiaoyun nodded in a dazed manner before focusing on the void. But because her situation was so bizarre, she had a hard time focusing.
A few short minutes later, Yuan brought Mei Xiaoyun out of the void.
"Well? What do you think?" he asked her in a somewhat exhausted voice.
Mei Xiaoyun did not respond, merely staring at him in silence.
Yuan didn't rush her and patiently waited.
After a long moment of silence, Mei Xiaoyun rubbed her eyes and sighed aloud, "I can't believe you just dragged me into the void with you. Do you have any idea how dangerous that is?"
"Don't worry, it's not my first time taking people with me into the void. Your safety is guaranteed."
"That's not the point! You should've warned me first!
"It's much quicker to show you."
Mei Xiaoyun released another sigh before speaking, "I... didn't really get to study the void too much because I wasn't mentally prepared for it."
"No worries. We'll do it as many times as you need. This is great training for me, too."
"I've heard about your unfathomably perfect Void Control and how abnormally fast your progress has been. Is this the secret behind it?" she asked.
She paused for a moment before adding, "Are you sure you want to share something like this with me? What if I share it with others?"
"I don't mind." Yuan casually shrugged. "Besides, I doubt anyone other than me could use this training method efficiently, given how dangerous it is."
The main reason Yuan's understanding of Void Manipulation improved so drastically was that he didn't protect his body while training, instead allowing the void to ravage him freely.
Such a training method would normally be impossible, as it required regenerative abilities powerful enough to constantly repair the damage inflicted on both his body.
"The Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique sure is convenient," she sighed.
"Give me a moment to mentally prepare myself before we try again."
Yuan nodded and said, "I will need some time to recover every time we do it, too."
Some time later, Yuan brought Mei Xiaoyun into the void once again.
This time, having mentally prepared herself beforehand, Mei Xiaoyun quickly entered a training mindset and began studying the void with intense concentration.
A few minutes later, they left the void.

"It's still too early to say how effective this method will be in the long run, but I can definitely feel my understanding of Void Control improving much faster than when I train normally," Mei Xiaoyun revealed afterward.
"That's good to hear. Want to continue training?" Yuan then asked.
She nodded.
"At least until the briefing in a few days."
Thus, they continued training in this manner for the next several days.

chapters.title: Chapter 2653 A Quick Briefing
paragraphs: *Knock* *Knock*
Someone knocked on Yuan's door as he rested from his training.
"I'll get it." Mei Xiaoyun said, not thinking too much about her actions before going to answer the door.
"Hey, Sergeant Yu—?!"
The voice abruptly halted when they noticed Yuan wasn't the one who answered the door.
"Y-You are... Private First Class Mei?! What are you doing inside Sergeant Yuan's living quarters?" Sergeant Bing asked with a bewildered expression.
Even as she voiced the question, however, a single conclusion had already taken root in her mind.
"We're training," Mei Xiaoyun said.
"Training... What sort of training can one even do in such an environment? If you're sparring, there are much better places..." Sergeant Bing continued to ask.
"Sorry, but it's not something I can reveal," Mei Xiaoyun shook her head.
"I-Is that so..." Sergeant Bing muttered in a dazed voice.
"You looking for me?"
A moment later, Yuan appeared at the door.

"Y-Yes..." Sergeant Bing snapped out of her daze and quickly explained the reason for her visit. "General Mei sent me to inform you that the briefing for the upcoming drill will take place tomorrow at ten in the morning. It'll take place at the Parade Deck, so make sure you don't miss it."
"I understand. Thanks for letting me know," said Yuan. "By the way, now that we're at the same rank, you can just call me by my name. Let the others know, too."
"Sure. You can call me by my name, too. I'm Bing Bing."
After Sergeant Bing left, Mei Xiaoyun said, "I'll also take my leave then. Thank you for the training."
"You can come back whenever you want to continue.
"I will."
The following day, Yuan, Mei Xiaoyun, Sergeant Bing, and Sergeant Quang made their way to the Parade Deck for their briefing.
By the time they arrived, nearly half of the military was already present.
"How many soldiers do we have, anyway?" Yuan suddenly asked.
"Approximately 70,000 soldiers."
"That's... a lot less than I expected."
"Well, it's not exactly easy to join the military."
About ten minutes later, the rest of the soldiers appeared.
At this moment, practically all 70,000 soldiers were present, with a few exceptions.
General Mei and General Gu were also present, both standing on an elevated platform.
Eventually, General Gu began speaking. "I know it hasn't been long since our last drill, but with Gaia's prophecy looming over us, we've decided to increase the frequency of these drills."
"Since we have new soldiers with us, we'll explain the purpose of the drill and the exercise to them."

Mei Feng then spoke, "The purpose of these drills is simple—to prepare us for what lies in the near future. Gaia, the protector of this world and Messenger of the Universe, received a prophecy from the universe itself. According to that prophecy, this world and every living being within it will one day face an unfathomable ordeal—a tribulation unlike anything we have ever experienced."
The soldiers who were already aware of the prophecy showed little reaction, aside from the firm determination visible on their faces.

However, those who had only recently joined the military and were hearing about it for the first time reacted with shock and disbelief, as though the peaceful future they had taken for granted had suddenly been ripped away.

"I won't go too deeply into the details of the prophecy, but there exist beings in this universe whose power is beyond anything we can currently comprehend. They dwell beyond the skies above us, and according to Gaia's prophecy, there will come a day when they descend upon this world with the intent to destroy mankind."
Mei Feng paused briefly before continuing, "During the drill, everyone here will be assigned a position somewhere within the city. Your objective is simple. Defend the city from the invading forces."
"In simpler words, it's an all-out war."

General Gu then spoke, "There are two things you must keep in mind. First, although you won't actually die during your clashes with the invaders, you can still be 'killed', which will result in you being 'removed' from the drill. In addition, a pain-enhancing formation will amplify the pain you experience. Its effect will begin at the maximum level and gradually weaken as the drill progresses, so do your best not to die too early.

"Second, every invader you defeat will earn you merit points, which can contribute toward your future promotions. If you defeat a certain number of invaders, you will receive additional rewards, such as Gaia's Gifts and powerful techniques."

Mei Feng spoke next. "The drill is scheduled to begin sometime next week, but we will not reveal the exact time. The moment the sirens sound, every soldier will be automatically teleported to their assigned position, regardless of whether they're ready."
She then swept her cold gaze across the area.

"That concludes the briefing. And for the newer soldiers, I shouldn't need to say this, but everything discussed here is strictly classified. Revealing any of this information to civilians carries the death penalty, so you are forbidden from sharing it with anyone—including your own family."
Once the generals left, the soldiers lingered to chat with each other.
"Man... we gotta do this drill even more frequently now? What a pain in the ass!"
"What are you talking about? This means there will be more opportunities to earn rewards and merits! This is a great change!"
"Please tell me it's a joke... That Gaia's prophecy is not real..."
"Sorry to break it to you, but it's real."
"W-Why...? Why can't we tell the civilians? I feel like something this important should be known by everyone..."
"Who knows?"
"You nervous?" Sergeant Quang asked Yuan.
He shook his head with a smile before asking, "How many invaders do we need to defeat for the rewards?"
"The minimum for a reward is 10. The most anyone has defeated is 979 invaders."
"How long is this drill?" Yuan continued asking. "Surely, it won't last for years..."
Sergeant Bing shrugged as she responded, "Who knows? It varies on our performance, and it has lasted for years in the past, so it's definitely possible."

General Mei and General Gu were also present, both standing on an elevated platform.
Eventually, General Gu began speaking.
"I know it hasn't been long since our last drill, but with Gaia's prophecy looming over us, we've decided to increase the frequency of these drills."
"Since we have new soldiers with us, we'll explain the purpose of the drill and the exercise to them."
Mei Feng then spoke, "The purpose of these drills is simple—to prepare us for what lies in the near future.
Gaia, the protector of this world and Messenger of the Universe, received a prophecy from the universe itself.
According to that prophecy, this world and every living being within it will one day face an unfathomable ordeal—a tribulation unlike anything we have ever experienced."
The soldiers who were already aware of the prophecy showed little reaction, aside from the firm determination visible on their faces.

However, those who had only recently joined the military and were hearing about it for the first time reacted with shock and disbelief, as though the peaceful future they had taken for granted had suddenly been ripped away.
"I won't go too deeply into the details of the prophecy, but there exist beings in this universe whose power is beyond anything we can currently comprehend.
They dwell beyond the skies above us, and according to Gaia's prophecy, there will come a day when they descend upon this world with the intent to destroy mankind."
Mei Feng paused briefly before continuing, "During the drill, everyone here will be assigned a position somewhere within the city.
Your objective is simple.
Defend the city from the invading forces."
"In simpler words, it's an all-out war."
General Gu then spoke, "There are two things you must keep in mind.
First, although you won't actually die during your clashes with the invaders, you can still be 'killed', which will result in you being 'removed' from the drill.
In addition, a pain-enhancing formation will amplify the pain you experience.
Its effect will begin at the maximum level and gradually weaken as the drill progresses, so do your best not to die too early.
"Second, every invader you defeat will earn you merit points, which can contribute toward your future promotions.
If you defeat a certain number of invaders, you will receive additional rewards, such as Gaia's Gifts and powerful techniques."
Mei Feng spoke next.
"The drill is scheduled to begin sometime next week, but we will not reveal the exact time.
The moment the sirens sound, every soldier will be automatically teleported to their assigned position, regardless of whether they're ready."
She then swept her cold gaze across the area.
"That concludes the briefing.
And for the newer soldiers, I shouldn't need to say this, but everything discussed here is strictly classified.
Revealing any of this information to civilians carries the death penalty, so you are forbidden from sharing it with anyone—including your own family."
Once the generals left, the soldiers lingered to chat with each other.
"Man... we gotta do this drill even more frequently now?
What a pain in the ass!"
"What are you talking about?
This means there will be more opportunities to earn rewards and merits!
This is a great change!"
"Please tell me it's a joke...
That Gaia's prophecy is not real..."
"Sorry to break it to you, but it's real."
"W-Why...?
Why can't we tell the civilians?
I feel like something this important should be known by everyone..."
"Who knows?"
"You nervous?" Sergeant Quang asked Yuan.
He shook his head with a smile before asking, "How many invaders do we need to defeat for the rewards?"
"The minimum for a reward is 10.
The most anyone has defeated is 979 invaders."
"How long is this drill?" Yuan continued asking.
"Surely, it won't last for years..."
Sergeant Bing shrugged as she responded, "Who knows?
It varies on our performance, and it has lasted for years in the past, so it's definitely possible."

chapters.title: Chapter 2654 Drill
paragraphs: When Sergeant Bing saw the frown on Yuan's face, she chuckled and said, "Are you worried about fighting for years without rest? Don't worry, there will be breaks here and there."
Yuan shook his head and said, "It's not the fighting that worries me. I don't want the drill to be that long, period."
Since he wouldn't be able to train during the drill, his progress would essentially come to a standstill until it ended, which was far from ideal.

"I wouldn't worry about that too much," Sergeant Quang suddenly said. "Although there were instances where a drill lasted for years, that only happened in the early days, when the system was still new, and nobody really knew what they were doing. Nowadays, drills usually last only a few weeks at most."
Yuan recalled the last drill and said, "Now that I think about it, the last drill ended quite fast."
"Oh, that was a special occasion. The drill had to be canceled for some reason," revealed Sergeant Bing.
"Is that so?"
"Anyway, I am going to prepare for the drill," said Sergeant Quang.
"How does one prepare for the drill?" Mei Xiaoyun asked.

"By doing nothing," replied Sergeant Bing. "Everyone who isn't out on a mission is prohibited from accepting new missions until it ends, and since the drill could happen at any moment, I also wouldn't waste my energy training, so just rest until then."
"Speaking of those who are still out on missions... what happens to them? Do they just get to skip the drill?" Yuan asked curiously.

"That rarely happens. Drills are announced months in advance, so everyone knows when to stop accepting missions and return to the city before it begins. But yes, if there is an emergency mission that cannot be delayed, those soldiers get to skip drill."
Some time later, Yuan and the others left the Parade Deck and returned to their living quarters.

Since there was no telling exactly when the drill would begin—or when they might suddenly be teleported to their assigned positions—most soldiers spent the next several days resting in their rooms. Others passed the time chatting, eating in the cafeteria, or spending time with friends.
As for Yuan, he spent his time studying the Limitless Cultivation Technique.
Six days later, the moment the clock struck three in the afternoon, sirens began blaring throughout the city.
The instant the civilians heard them, they rushed toward the teleporters, evacuating to the underground city.
Meanwhile, every soldier immediately stopped whatever they were doing and prepared to be teleported to their assigned positions.
Yuan opened his eyes to see a notification before him.
<You will be teleported to Sector 7 in 60 seconds>
Sixty seconds later, Yuan was teleported directly from his room to Sector 7.

Once the teleportation was complete, he looked around and found himself standing atop a rooftop somewhere within the sector. Other soldiers were stationed throughout the surrounding area, though none were close enough for a conversation, as they were about three miles away from each other.
He couldn't see Mei Xiaoyun or the others nearby, so he assumed they were assigned to a different sector.
"So this won't be a team-based event, huh?" Yuan mumbled as he looked toward the sky.
The once-clear blue sky was rapidly darkening, as though a massive storm were closing in from all directions.
A few minutes later, cracks suddenly began appearing across the pitch-black sky, as though countless spears had pierced through it from the other side.
Then, silhouettes emerged from the openings, slowly descending toward the world below.
The moment they appeared, the atmosphere throughout the entire city shifted. An indescribable pressure descended with them, blanketing everything beneath the darkened sky.

Yuan narrowed his eyes at the descending silhouettes. They had humanoid figures and ghostly pale skin, with a pair of large, bat-like wings flapping behind their backs. Their faces also resembled humans, yet their expressions remained eerily blank, making them seem like soulless beings devoid of emotion.
As for their cultivation levels, they varied greatly, ranging from the Third Ascension all the way to the Seventh Ascension.
Ding!
<Military Drill: Stop the Celestial Beings' invasion on Earth!>
Shortly after their appearance, the Celestial Beings made the first move, unleashing a barrage of Limitless that rained down upon the soldiers like a violent storm.
The soldiers responded by shielding themselves with Limitless. Some avoided them entirely with Void Control.
"This is... quite boring," Yuan muttered as he counterattacked with his own Limitless, firing at the Celestial Beings still descending from the sky.
The moment his Limitless collided with theirs, the enemy attacks shattered with no resistance. Yuan's attack then continued forward and struck one of the Celestial Beings, killing it instantly.
<Celestial Being defeated>
<Total Points: 1>
After defeating the Celestial Being that had been targeting him, Yuan turned his attention toward the others.
At a glance, it seemed that each soldier had been assigned a single Celestial Being to deal with.
A few minutes later, Yuan lifted his head toward the sky when he noticed more Celestial Beings were appearing.
"Two of them this time, huh?" Yuan mumbled to himself as he gazed at the two Celestial Beings that appeared side by side.
A burst of Limitless surged from Yuan's body before he unleashed a barrage of Limitless bullets at the Celestial Beings, destroying them before they could even attack.
<Celestial Being defeated>
<Total Points: 3>
Meanwhile, the others were still on their first Celestial Being.
As boring as the drill seemed at first, Yuan didn't complain, as he could tell that the difficulty would gradually increase.
'Hm? Wait a second. Am I only allowed to attack the Celestial Beings targeting me, or can I help the others?' Yuan suddenly wondered.
After pondering for a moment, he decided to test it himself. Without leaving his assigned position, Yuan launched an attack at a Celestial Being already engaged in combat with another soldier.
<Celestial Being defeated>
<Total Points: 4>
Upon confirming that he could assist the others, Yuan felt a strong urge to defeat every Celestial Being in the area by himself. However, he ultimately restrained himself.
'This is a drill, after all. I should let the others get some experience. I'll only step in if things start getting out of hand,' he thought before he waited for more Celestial Beings to show up.

chapters.title: Chapter 2655 Drill(2)
paragraphs: <Celestial Being defeated>
<Total Points: 50>
A few hours had passed since the drill began, and Yuan had just slain his 50th Celestial Being. Meanwhile, the soldiers around him were still struggling with their third or fourth opponent.
A few more hours passed, but Yuan's points remained the same, as Celestial Beings had stopped spawning for him.
With nothing else to do, he decided to study the Limitless Cultivation Technique instead.
Meanwhile, somewhere within Gaia's Heaven, two individuals watched the ongoing drill through a massive screen.
One of these individuals possessed a tall, slender figure and long, pitch-black hair that cascaded down their back like a curtain, clearly a woman.
"Who is that man with fifty points already?" asked the black-haired woman.

The other individual, an old man with long white hair and a neatly trimmed white beard, responded, "That's Sergeant Yuan, a new soldier who joined the military a little over a year ago. However, very little is known about him. There is essentially no record of him prior to joining the military, as if he'd appeared out of thin air."
The black-haired woman then made a graceful gesture with their hand, summoning a system screen before them. It displayed Yuan's information, including details that weren't accessible to the public.
"T-That's...!" The old man exclaimed in surprise. "Perfected Heavenly Refinement?! But when I looked at it before, it showed Inexhaustible Heavenly Refinement!"
"His information was altered."
"That explains it..." the old man muttered. "If I had suspected that his information had been altered, I would've dug deeper. This was my mistake."
After a moment of silence, he continued, "This is the first time someone has achieved the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique. However, it doesn't match his cultivation."
The black-haired woman did not respond, only continuing to read through Yuan's information in silence.
"Truly a peculiar individual... I would like to meet him."
"Y-You?" The old man wore a shocked expression after hearing those words.
"Not right now. There is still so much I need to learn about him before I decide if it's safe to meet him. For all we know, he could be a Celestial Being."
"A Celestial Being?!" the old man exclaimed in disbelief.
"It's just speculation right now. His existence is clearly otherworldly, but whether he is a Celestial Being or not is a different matter."
"Is it possible to ask... you know..." asked the old man.
"If only it were that simple..." sighed the black-haired woman.
She continued a moment later, "With all that said, I'm not too worried. After all, General Mei seems to trust him, and I trust her judgment."

"General Mei, huh?" the old man sighed bitterly. "If I could, I would hand my position over to her rather than that poisonous bastard surnamed Gu. Unfortunately, there are rules within the military that even I cannot ignore."
"Maybe you should—"
"No, I won't intervene," the woman interrupted. "I have faith in General Mei. I believe she is destined to overcome this challenge on her own, without my assistance."
She turned to look at the screen spectating the drill and continued, "Especially if she has someone like that on her side."
Time passed swiftly, and before anyone realized it, an entire week had already passed since the drill began.
Yuan, who had been cultivating for the majority of the drill, suddenly opened his eyes as a notification had appeared before him.
<Warm-up will be ending soon>
<The real drill will begin in three days>
When the new soldiers, who had never participated in a drill before, saw the notification and realized the entire past week had only been a warm-up, many of them began to despair.
If what they'd experienced had only been the warm-up, they could hardly imagine how outrageous the real drill would be.
After another day, once all of the Celestial Beings had been defeated, the 3-day countdown began.
<Resting period has begun>
The moment the break began, many soldiers collapsed to the ground, breathing heavily as they tried to recover from their exhaustion.
"Hey, newbie. If you're already this exhausted after the warm-up, you won't last ten minutes once the real thing begins," an experienced soldier remarked.
"W-What is the real thing like...?" the new soldier asked nervously, almost afraid to hear the answer.
"You'll find out in three days."
Meanwhile, the soldiers stationed near Yuan silently stared at him while they rested.
Although they had spent the entire warm-up fighting almost nonstop, they had all noticed that the Celestial Beings had stopped spawning for Yuan at some point.
"There have been fewer than ten people who have managed to clear the warm-up..." one of them suddenly remarked.
"And he'd done it without his weapon."
"Now that you mentioned it, where is his weapon? I heard that he uses a minigun, too."
"Who knows?"
"Does a monster like him even need one?"

Weapons primarily served to assist their wielder's control over Limitless, allowing them to use it more efficiently and unleash greater power while consuming less energy. However, Yuan had little to no need for such assistance, so his weapon was mostly for show.
Time continued to pass, and in what felt like the blink of an eye, their 3-day rest period came to an end.
<Resting period has ended>
<Work together with your fellow soldiers to protect this world from destruction!>
Shortly after the notification appeared, the sky once again turned pitch-black.

This time, however, instead of countless smaller openings, a single massive slit resembling an eye slowly opened across the darkened sky. From beyond it, an ominous black fog began pouring into the world.
Of course, this wasn't ordinary black fog. It was actually countless Celestial Beings packed so densely together that, from a distance, they resembled a massive cloud of black fog.
"Holy shit..."
The new soldiers stared at the scene in bewilderment, their eyes wide and mouths agape.
Even the seasoned soldiers who had witnessed and endured it multiple times before couldn't help but swallow nervously.
"Now this is more like it..." Yuan mumbled with a calm smile on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 2656 Drill(3)
paragraphs: Shortly after the real drill began and the Celestial Beings started pouring down from the sky, Yuan made the first move, unleashing a barrage of Limitless at the massive horde still descending.
Since this was now a group effort, he no longer had any reason to hold back.
<Defeated a Celestial Being>
<Defeated a Celestial Being>
<Defeated a Celestial Being>
<Total Points: 154>
In the blink of an eye, Yuan tripled his points by defeating all of the weaker Celestial Beings first.
"This guy is truly outrageous!"
The other soldiers stared at Yuan with wide eyes, their expressions filled with shock.
Yuan ignored them completely and shot into the sky, charging straight toward the sea of Celestial Beings as though he intended to take on the entire army by himself.
"What the hell is he doing?!"
"Does he intend to fight them all by himself?! That's ridiculous!"
"He's clearly just trying to show off, but at this rate, he'll only get himself killed and removed from the drill early," one of the soldiers said.

"Yeah. Let's stop paying attention to him and focus on ourselves. This may only be a drill, but our performance here can have a huge impact on our chances of promotion, especially if you're aiming to become an officer!"

However, Yuan wasn't the only soldier charging toward the Celestial Beings. Several others were doing the same, most of them being experienced soldiers and officers. Meanwhile, the newer soldiers and those less confident in their abilities remained behind. Of course, these soldiers made up the majority of the military.
"That guy..."
Not too far away, in Sector 1, Ironwoman spotted Yuan ahead of her, immediately igniting her competitive spirit.

Ever since discovering Yuan and his overwhelming talent, she had wanted to compete with him. However, the difference in their ranks and cultivation had never given her a proper opportunity to do so—until now.

Meanwhile, the Celestial Beings did not simply wait for the soldiers to attack. They immediately bombarded everyone approaching with a massive wave of Limitless that spread outward like an enormous wall, leaving no room to evade normally.

Although Yuan could have avoided the attack using Void Manipulation, he chose to confront it head-on. With a slash of his arm, he unleashed a wave of Limitless infused with Supreme Sword Aura and a small trace of Eternal Essence.

A sword light flickered into existence and collided with the massive wall of Limitless. The two forces remained locked against each other for a good moment before Yuan's attack finally broke through, slicing the wall cleanly in half and splitting the torrent of energy in two.
The scene shocked all of the soldiers watching, their jaws dropping wide open.
After breaking through the Celestial Beings' attack, Yuan immediately used Void Manipulation to close the distance in an instant.
However, instead of confronting the army from the front, he teleported directly into the heart of their formation, deliberately allowing himself to be surrounded.
Despite Yuan's unexpected actions, the Celestial Beings showed no visible reaction and calmly attacked him.

Not wanting to go overboard with his performance, Yuan kept his use of Eternal Essence to a bare minimum, relying on it only to defend against particularly dangerous attacks and never using it offensively.
Instead, he used Supreme Sword Aura and Limitless, which was already more than enough to deal with many of the Celestial Beings there.
<Defeated a Celestial Being>
<Defeated a Celestial Being>
<Total Points: 284>
Yuan's points skyrocketed thanks to his bold and aggressive strategy, nearly doubling within mere moments.
Seeing this, Ironwoman unleashed her full cultivation. The power of her ninth-level Seventh Ascension cultivation instantly swept across the area, causing even the air itself to tremble.

Once she reached the Celestial Beings and began fighting them, her points also rose rapidly. However, her pace was nowhere near Yuan's. Despite having a much lower cultivation, Yuan was defeating the Celestial Beings far faster than she was.
Of course, the Ironwoman didn't know this, as she was too focused on the Celestial Beings to pay attention to Yuan, much less count his kills.
Time passed, and although Yuan was constantly defeating and holding off hundreds of Celestial Beings on his own, they continued pouring endlessly from the eye-shaped slit in the sky.
Eventually, their sheer numbers overwhelmed the soldiers fighting in the air, allowing the Celestial Beings to reach the city and clash with the soldiers below.

It didn't take long for the drill to erupt into a full-blown war, with over a hundred thousand beings locked in fierce combat at once. The once-peaceful city had transformed into a massive battlefield, with unimaginable destruction unfolding in every corner.
However, the Celestial Beings vastly outnumbered the soldiers, forcing nearly everyone to fight at least two enemies at once, while some had to contend with three or more.
Faced with such overwhelming numbers, it didn't take long for the newer soldiers to realize the battle was unwinnable and defeat inevitable.

As for the veteran soldiers who had experienced the drill before, they were already well aware of this. In fact, throughout the history of the drills, the soldiers had never once succeeded in repelling the invasion.
It didn't take long for the soldiers to start dying to the Celestial Beings, and within minutes, their numbers began dropping like flies.

Within an hour, nearly a quarter of the soldiers had already died and been removed from the drill. Whenever a soldier 'died' in battle, they were automatically teleported to a separate area, where they would remain until the drill concluded.
By the end of the first day, only half of the 70,000 soldiers remained.

As for the Celestial Beings, their numbers only continued to grow, seemingly without end. Moreover, every newly spawned Celestial Being possessed a cultivation of at least the Fifth Ascension, meaning their forces were only growing stronger as the battle progressed, as the weaker ones no longer spawned.
The third day came and passed, and by the end, less than ten thousand soldiers remained.

sentences.text: Shortly after the real drill began and the Celestial Beings started pouring down from the sky, Yuan made the first move, unleashing a barrage of Limitless at the massive horde still descending.
Since this was now a group effort, he no longer had any reason to hold back.
<Defeated a Celestial Being>
<Defeated a Celestial Being>
<Defeated a Celestial Being>
<Total Points: 154>
In the blink of an eye, Yuan tripled his points by defeating all of the weaker Celestial Beings first.
"This guy is truly outrageous!"
The other soldiers stared at Yuan with wide eyes, their expressions filled with shock.
Yuan ignored them completely and shot into the sky, charging straight toward the sea of Celestial Beings as though he intended to take on the entire army by himself.
"What the hell is he doing?!"
"Does he intend to fight them all by himself?!
That's ridiculous!"
"He's clearly just trying to show off, but at this rate, he'll only get himself killed and removed from the drill early," one of the soldiers said.
"Yeah.
Let's stop paying attention to him and focus on ourselves.
This may only be a drill, but our performance here can have a huge impact on our chances of promotion, especially if you're aiming to become an officer!"
However, Yuan wasn't the only soldier charging toward the Celestial Beings.
Several others were doing the same, most of them being experienced soldiers and officers.
Meanwhile, the newer soldiers and those less confident in their abilities remained behind.
Of course, these soldiers made up the majority of the military.
"That guy..."
Not too far away, in Sector 1, Ironwoman spotted Yuan ahead of her, immediately igniting her competitive spirit.
Ever since discovering Yuan and his overwhelming talent, she had wanted to compete with him.
However, the difference in their ranks and cultivation had never given her a proper opportunity to do so—until now.
Meanwhile, the Celestial Beings did not simply wait for the soldiers to attack.
They immediately bombarded everyone approaching with a massive wave of Limitless that spread outward like an enormous wall, leaving no room to evade normally.
Although Yuan could have avoided the attack using Void Manipulation, he chose to confront it head-on.
With a slash of his arm, he unleashed a wave of Limitless infused with Supreme Sword Aura and a small trace of Eternal Essence.
A sword light flickered into existence and collided with the massive wall of Limitless.
The two forces remained locked against each other for a good moment before Yuan's attack finally broke through, slicing the wall cleanly in half and splitting the torrent of energy in two.
The scene shocked all of the soldiers watching, their jaws dropping wide open.
After breaking through the Celestial Beings' attack, Yuan immediately used Void Manipulation to close the distance in an instant.
However, instead of confronting the army from the front, he teleported directly into the heart of their formation, deliberately allowing himself to be surrounded.
Despite Yuan's unexpected actions, the Celestial Beings showed no visible reaction and calmly attacked him.

Not wanting to go overboard with his performance, Yuan kept his use of Eternal Essence to a bare minimum, relying on it only to defend against particularly dangerous attacks and never using it offensively.
Instead, he used Supreme Sword Aura and Limitless, which was already more than enough to deal with many of the Celestial Beings there.

<Defeated a Celestial Being>
<Total Points: 284>
Yuan's points skyrocketed thanks to his bold and aggressive strategy, nearly doubling within mere moments.

The power of her ninth-level Seventh Ascension cultivation instantly swept across the area, causing even the air itself to tremble.
Once she reached the Celestial Beings and began fighting them, her points also rose rapidly.

Of course, the Ironwoman didn't know this, as she was too focused on the Celestial Beings to pay attention to Yuan, much less count his kills.

It didn't take long for the drill to erupt into a full-blown war, with over a hundred thousand beings locked in fierce combat at once.
The once-peaceful city had transformed into a massive battlefield, with unimaginable destruction unfolding in every corner.

chapters.title: Chapter 2657 The Last Three Survivors
paragraphs: As more and more soldiers were killed and removed from the drill, the burden on those remaining only grew heavier, forcing them to take on an increasing number of Celestial Beings at once.

Since this was a group effort, practically every soldier fought alongside a squad, including Ironwoman. The only ones still fighting alone were those whose teammates had already been eliminated or who were too surrounded by enemies to receive any assistance.
Of course, there was Yuan, who was fighting alone by choice.
Not only had he been fighting alone this entire time, but he wasn't even fighting seriously.
'What was the record again? 979 Celestial Beings?'
Yuan looked at his own score as he avoided the Celestial Beings' attacks left and right.
<Total Points: 4,162>
Before he realized it, he'd already surpassed the record more than four times.
'Well, there's nothing I can do now that I've passed the record. But I should still hold back a little...' Yuan thought to himself.
Time continued to pass, and at the end of the fourth day, the number of soldiers halved.
By the end of the fifth day, the number fell even more, and less than a thousand soldiers remained on the battlefield.
In less than a week, the entire city had been reduced to ruins, without a single building left standing.

At the start of the seventh day, exactly a week after the real drill began, the number of soldiers had fallen to below a hundred. Meanwhile, there were still thousands... tens of thousands of Celestial Beings.

However, even though the Celestial Beings vastly outnumbered the soldiers, it wasn't as though the soldiers had to fight all of them at once, as there was clearly a limit to how many could engage each soldier at any given time.

Even so, most of the soldiers were utterly exhausted and barely holding on. By the end of the seventh day, their numbers had dwindled by eighty percent, leaving fewer than twenty soldiers left in the drill.
"I don't get it. How is someone at the Fifth Ascension able to last this long?" a soldier suddenly asked aloud.
Soldiers who had been removed from the drill were allowed to spectate the remaining participants, and at that moment, most of them were watching Yuan.
"Well, he's famous for having a tremendous and abnormal amount of energy. I heard he could wield the minigun nonstop for days.
"He must have a powerful technique that allows him to recover his Limitless. Otherwise, it doesn't make any sense."
"To possess such a powerful technique... I wonder where he's from."
"I heard a rumor saying that he's actually from another city."
"How much longer do you think he'll last? He's slowed down tremendously compared to yesterday."
Five more soldiers fell within the next six hours.
"It's really hard to believe that he's a new soldier. His combat experience is on another level..."
"For a combat instructor like you to praise him so highly..."
After another six hours, the number of soldiers remaining fell below ten.
"To think he'd reach the top 10 on his first drill!"
"Do you think he's broken the previous record of the most Celestial Beings defeated?"
"Definitely, but he won't be the only one to break a record. Seeing how the Ironwoman is taking this drill seriously, she'll likely break it, too."
"I guess she's heard the rumor of Sergeant Yuan being seen as her rival."
By the end of the eighth day, only three soldiers were left in the drill.
The Ironwoman, Yuan, and another soldier bearing the insignia of a Colonel.
"Congratulations, General Mei! With two of our soldiers, Ironwoman and Sergeant Yuan, dominating the drill, General Gu must be shaking with worry!" one of her officers remarked.
Mei Feng nodded and said, "Although the drill is important, it won't be enough to secure my promotion.
The drill continued for another three days without anyone else being eliminated. However, two days later, the Colonel finally fell, leaving only Ironwoman and Yuan left in the drill.
'So it's just the two of us now...'
Yuan briefly considered whether he should continue or simply give up and let Ironwoman take the victory—even though this wasn't a competition.

After some thought, however, he decided against giving up so easily. It would undoubtedly draw even more unnecessary attention to himself, but at this point, he felt it was already too late to worry about that.
'Let's see how long you can last!'
One day... two days... three days passed with only Ironwoman and Yuan remaining on the battlefield, yet neither of them showed any signs of nearing defeat.
Five days... six days... seven...
The drill entered its second week, yet Ironwoman and Yuan still remained on the battlefield.

Yuan had long since given up on defeating the Celestial Beings and shifted his focus entirely to survival, using Void Manipulation nonstop to evade their attacks. His main reason for not fighting them was simply because he didn't want to increase his points too much, but another reason was that the Celestial Beings being spawned are all at least the Seventh Ascension.
"That guy is trying to outlast the Ironwoman!"
"Isn't it technically cheating if he's not even fighting anymore?" one of the spectators remarked.

"Not really... Just look at the difference in their cultivation. It'd be unreasonable to expect him to keep fighting them at this point. Hell, I'd even argue that using Void Control nonstop is more exhausting than fighting."

"What's the point of continuing if he's not going to fight? The purpose of this drill isn't to survive for as long as possible, but to defeat as many Celestial Beings as you can. If you can't do that anymore, you might as well give up."
Yuan's actions quickly divided the spectators into two camps. One side supported his actions, while the other questioned the point of continuing.
"Knowing him, he's probably using this opportunity to train his Void Control," said Shi Fa.
"Not probably. Definitely," said Wu Wang.

chapters.title: Chapter 2658 End of the Drill
paragraphs: Another week has passed since Yuan and Ironwoman became the last two survivors of the drill, meaning they'd spent three weeks fight nonstop at this point.
'Looks like she's on her last leg.' Yuan thought to himself after seeing the Ironwoman's condition.
'I guess it's about time for me to give up...'
However, Yuan suddenly realized something.
'Will I even be able to lose?' he wondered inwardly.
After all, with his regeneration, it might be impossible for him to die normally. Moreover, he was worried about revealing his healing capabilities to the military.
'I am already suspected of being a Void Specter... If I reveal my regeneration ability, that might give them more ammunition against me.'
After some consideration, Yuan decided against giving up. In fact, he decided that if he had already made it this far, he might as well survive until the end.
A few hours later, Ironwoman finally exhausted all of her energy and fell to the Celestial Beings.
"H-He actually outlasted the Ironwoman!"
The spectators were left in awe by the unexpected outcome, as everyone was certain that the Ironwoman would be the last survivor.
"How much longer do you think he'll last?"
"What's the point of trying to stay alive now that he's the last one standing? He's already proved his point."
"Right? It's not like he can defeat the Celestial Beings, either."

Shortly after Ironwoman was removed from the drill, Yuan decided to give up as well. Since he was already the last survivor, there was no point in continuing, especially when even he couldn't defeat the Celestial Beings without relying on Eternal Essence.

To avoid making his surrender too obvious, Yuan continued dodging their attacks for several more minutes before deliberately allowing one of the Celestial Beings to land a direct hit, its Limitless striking him squarely in the heart.
"Damn it..."
Yuan let out a deep sigh when he realized he hadn't died or been removed from the drill.
His greatest concern had come true. Because of his regeneration, he was literally incapable of dying through normal means.
'Let's try this again...'

After pretending like the first strike wasn't fatal, Yuan continued evading the Celestial Beings' attack for another minute before letting them strike him again. This time, however, he struck himself with his own Eternal Essence, ensuring that he died from it.
<You have died>
<You have been teleported>
Yuan found himself back in the military base at the Parade Deck after being teleported.
Moments later, Mei Feng and General Gu appeared before them and said, "With the last soldier out of the battlefield, we will end the drill here."

General Gu continued, "Although the drill ends here, it will not be the last one, and we intend to have another one in three years. Those of you who performed poorly during this drill will be required to participate in supplementary training. That is all."
Mei Feng then said, "Besides Ironwoman and Sergeant Yuan, you're all now dismissed."
The soldiers scattered the next moment.
"Come with me to my office," Mei Feng said to Yuan and Ironwoman afterward.
Some time later, once they were inside her office, Mei Feng said, "First and foremost, I want to say good work. You've both managed to perform beyond expectations and even broken the record."
She turned to look at Yuan and asked, "What did you think of the drill?"
"Quite frankly, I'm a little disappointed," he shrugged.
"Can you elaborate?" Mei Feng asked, raising an eyebrow at his response.
"There's not much to it. Do we simply fight until we can't fight anymore? What's the purpose of that?" Yuan asked.

Mei Feng remained silent for a moment before responding, "Because we don't know the full extent of the threat we'll face in the future, we can only prepare in a way that gives our soldiers the greatest chance of survival. If the drill is too easy, they won't learn anything from it and will be woefully unprepared when the real threat arrives."
"With that being said, it's not impossible to win the drill. It just hasn't happened yet."
"Is there a reward for beating it?" Yuan then asked.
"I knew you'd ask that," Mei Feng sighed before responding, "But to answer your question... no, not really, but the better your performance, the faster you'll be promoted, which is your goal, right?
Yuan nodded.
"Well, considering your performance this time... I won't be surprised if you've already earned enough merits to be promoted again, even though you've just received your promotion."
Yuan then said, "Speaking of promotions... when does my credential rank increase? It's been a while since it happened."
Mei Feng fell silent for a moment before a look of realization appeared on her face.
"I forgot to tell you, but your credential rank doesn't automatically increase after rank 3. You'll need to manually apply for an upgrade."
"Seriously?" Yuan sighed out loud.
"Sorry." Mei Feng apologized.
"Well, that's fine. Where do I go to increase it?"
"I can show you after this," said Ironwoman.
"Okay."
The Ironwoman then asked, "Anyway, why'd you call us?"
Mei Feng's expression turned serious as she responded, "An assembly has been initiated. I believe you know what'll be discussed even without needing me to say it."
The Ironwoman quietly turned her head to look at Yuan.
"I think I have an idea," she said a moment later.

"The highest-ranking authority from each military will be attending this assembly, so our Supreme General will have to travel to the meeting location. I want the two of you to escort him there," Mei Feng said.
"Wait..." Ironwoman quickly interjected. "I understand why you'd want to send me, but why send him as well when he's the main subject of the discussion?"

"I have two reasons. First, I hope to clear up the misunderstanding before it spreads any further. Second... I want him to become acquainted with the Supreme General. Although the Supreme General will likely seek him out sooner or later after his performance at the drill, I'd rather it be sooner than later."

chapters.title: Chapter 2659 Assembly
paragraphs: "I understand that you want him to form a connection with the Supreme General, but I still don't think it's a good idea to send a new soldier like him on a mission like this, especially when we'll be meeting some of the highest-ranking individuals from the other militaries. Surely, there are other ways to introduce the two of them."
Ironwoman shook her head, worried that the other cities would look down on them for sending a mere Sergeant to such an important assembly.

Although Ironwoman herself wasn't particularly high-ranking within the military, her prowess and reputation far surpassed those of even some of the highest-ranking soldiers in Gaia's Heaven, so it made sense for her to participate in the assembly.

Yuan, however, was essentially an unknown soldier outside of their city. Even worse, he was currently suspected of being a Void Specter by another city, even being the reason the assembly was happening in the first place.
Rather than making the decision on her own, Mei Feng turned to look at Yuan and asked him, "What do you think? Do you want to go? I won't force you if you refuse."

"Just to clarify, you want me to escort the Supreme General to this assembly, where they'll likely talk about me being a Void Specter, and try to convince them that I am actually a human?" Yuan asked for clarification.
"Indeed." Mei Feng nodded.
"What if I fail to convince them and do the opposite?" Yuan then asked.

After a moment of silence, Mei Feng responded, "If you fail to convince them that you're human—or somehow make the situation even worse—you could end up becoming an enemy of every other city. Hell, there's even a chance you might be exiled from this city."
"Exile, huh? That sounds fun," Yuan calmly remarked with a smile on his face.
"Anyway, I want to go to this assembly. It sounds too fun to miss," he then said.

"Then I'll put your name on the list. Also, it won't just be the two of you, as General Gu will also send two of his own soldiers. Of course, there's also the Ninth Division, who answers only to the Supreme General."
After a brief pause, Mei Feng continued, "The assembly will happen next month, but since it won't take place in any city, you won't be able to teleport there."
"One last thing... Although it's unlikely General Gu's soldiers will try to do anything funny in the Supreme General's presence, it's not guaranteed, so stay alert," Mei Feng said, warning Yuan.
"I will keep that in mind."
"You'll start your journey in three days, so do whatever you need until then. That's all."
Yuan left the office shortly after, leaving Ironwoman behind.
"I don't really have much to say to you. Just keep an eye out for him," Mei Feng said to Ironwoman after Yuan left.
The Ironwoman nodded before asking, "What did you think of the drill? About his performance? I didn't have the luxury to pay attention during, but I'll definitely watch the recording later."
"Hard to say. I don't know if I should be happy or disappointed."
"Huh? Why would you be disappointed?" Ironwoman inquired, raising an eyebrow.
"Because it didn't seem like he was giving it his all during the drill." Mei Feng sighed.
"On one hand, I'm glad he managed to become the last survivor. On the other hand, I was hoping to see him do much more."
"He probably didn't want to attract any more attention than he already had, especially with the entire military watching."
"I know, but I really want to see him go all out—to see what he's truly capable of."
"Give him a little more time. Knowing his character and arrogance, he'll definitely show it to us in the near future."

Ironwoman nodded and said, "Follow me."

"Just tell them you're here to see if you qualify for a credential upgrade."
"Okay."
Yuan approached the front desk and asked, "I'm here to see if I qualify for a credential upgrade."
The worker then gestured toward the usual machine before Yuan.
Yuan placed his hand in the machine and allowed it to consume a drop of his blood.
A moment later, the worker's expression changed drastically, causing Yuan to raise an eyebrow.
"P-Please wait a moment..."
Without any explanation, the worker stood up and rushed into the room in the back.
"What happened?"
The Ironwoman approached Yuan and asked after seeing this unusual response.
"I don't know."
Several minutes passed without any sign of the worker.
Suddenly, Yuan noticed a group of soldiers wearing uniforms different from those he was accustomed to entering the building.
These soldiers walked straight to Yuan and said to him, "Sergeant Yuan, you're currently under arrest. Please do not resist and come with us peacefully."
Yuan raised an eyebrow at this unexpected situation, but before he could even say anything, the Ironwoman stepped forward and asked, "What the hell is going on? Why is he being arrested?"
The soldiers looked at her and responded, "Sorry, but even we don't know the details."
Ironwoman frowned upon hearing this. Whatever was happening must be incredibly serious if even the military police didn't know the details.
She turned to Yuan and said, "Just go with them for now and find out what this is about. I'll speak with General Mei first, then come find you."
"Okay." Yuan nodded, then calmly followed the military police away.
Meanwhile, Ironwoman rushed back to General Mei's office and informed her of the situation.
Mei Feng immediately rose from her seat upon hearing the news, disbelief written across her face.
"There's no way an arrest order could've been issued for him without me knowing about it!" she exclaimed.

chapters.title: Chapter 2660 Arrested Again
paragraphs: "Did the military police reveal the reason for his arrest?" Mei Feng asked.
"No, I asked them, but they claim to not know the details, either."
The frown on Mei Feng's face deepened.

"Only Generals are able to issue arrest orders to the military police without giving a proper reason, so it's likely that General Gu had something to do with this. For such a thing to happen right before the assembly, what shitty timing!" Mei Feng cursed aloud.
She then said to the Ironwoman, "Go to Sergeant Yuan and ensure nothing happens to him while I go speak with General Gu."
"I understand."

While the Ironwoman went to the military prison, Mei Feng made her way to General Gu's office. Although Mei Feng could contact General Gu much faster on the phone, she felt it would be more effective to show up in person.
Some time later—
"What did you just say?"
The Ironwoman questioned with a deep frown on her face.
"Sergeant Yuan is no longer with us... He was escorted away literally the moment we took him here," said the military police who arrested Yuan.
"Who took him away? Was it General Gu?"
"General Gu?" The military soldier repeated in a puzzled tone before responding, "No, the one who escorted him away was..."
"What?!" Ironwoman exclaimed in disbelief.
Meanwhile, Mei Feng arrived at General Gu's office.
"General Mei? You've been visiting my office an awful lot recently. What is it this time?" General Gu glared at her with an unwelcoming expression.
"Why did you put an arrest order for Sergeant Yuan?" Mei Feng went straight to the point.
"An arrest order? What are you talking about?" General Gu replied with a genuinely puzzled face.
"Don't play dumb. Only you and I can arrest someone without giving a reason."
General Gu rubbed his eyes and sighed, "I don't know what to tell you except that I had nothing to do with it. If Sergeant Yuan was arrested, then it was because of his own doing."
"You—!"
Just as Mei Feng opened her mouth to speak, she noticed the Ironwoman was calling her.
"What happened?"
"It's Sergeant Yuan. He was escorted away by the time I reached the prison, and you won't believe this, but I don't think General Gu had anything to do with his arrest.
"What...?" Mei Feng wore a dumbfounded look on her face after hearing this.
Her eyes glanced at General Gu, and sure enough, he looked genuinely confused by the whole situation.
"Who arrested him?" she then asked.
"That would be..."
"What?!" Mei Feng exclaimed in disbelief after hearing the response. "Why would they arrest him?!"
"I don't know, but this is the first time anything like this has happened before."
"Alright... I'll be with you in a moment."
After hanging up, Mei Feng returned her attention to General Gu but said nothing.
"Sounds like you made a mistake, General Mei," General Gu spoke first, breaking the silence.
"If I really made a mistake, I'll apologize for it. However, since I don't have all of the information, I'll wait until I do."
After saying that, Mei Feng turned around and left.
Once Mei Feng left, General Gu made his own call.
"I just received news that Sergeant Yuan was arrested. I want every piece of information you can find on it!"
Meanwhile, somewhere within the military base, Yuan sat inside an empty white room that resembled a seclusion room in a psychiatric ward.
Seated across from him was a group of individuals dressed in white uniforms resembling those worn by scientists.
"So, what is this all about?" Yuan finally asked after several minutes had passed without anyone saying a word.
One of them responded, "Do you really have no idea why you're here?"
Yuan calmly shook his head.
"Do you even know where you are right now?" another asked.
"Should I?"
After another moment of silence, one of the individuals in white retrieved an Unknown Ore and placed it on the desk before them.
"Do you know what this is?"
"An Unknown Ore?
"Anything special about it?"
Yuan fell silent as he stared at the Unknown Ore.
'I see... so this is what it's about...' Yuan sighed inwardly as he realized what was happening.
The Unknown Ore sitting before him was obviously one he had personally collected—and completely drained of its energy.
"Well?"
One of the individuals spoke again when Yuan didn't respond.
Yuan shook his head and said, "It looks like an ordinary Unknown Ore to me."
"It is indeed an Unknown Ore, but there is nothing ordinary about it."
They retrieved another piece of Unknown Ore and placed it beside the first, but there was a clear difference between the two.
Unlike the first, which glistened like a first-rate jewel, the second lacked its usual shimmering appearance and looked like nothing more than an ordinary piece of colorless crystal.

"It may be hard to believe, but these two are actually the same," one of them explained. "Normally, when an Unknown Ore loses all of its energy, it also loses its glistening appearance and ends up looking like this. However, for some reason, this one retained its original appearance despite having no energy left."
"Okay...?" Yuan muttered.
"Why are you telling me this?" he asked.
"Because we're hoping you can help us solve this phenomenon."
"And what makes you think I have the answer to your question?"
"For starters, this Unknown Ore was collected by you. In fact..."

One of the individuals stood up, walked to the side of the room, retrieved a spatial cube, and emptied its contents onto the floor. In the blink of an eye, thousands of glistening Unknown Ores formed a massive pile.
"All of these were gathered by you. More importantly, out of everyone in the military, you're the only person who has ever brought back Unknown Ores like these."
"And whatever you say next, please don't tell us it's a coincidence, because none of us will believe you."
After those words, the room fell silent once again as Yuan stared quietly at the massive pile of Unknown Ores before him.

chapters.title: Chapter 2661 Arrested Again(2)
paragraphs: While it wasn't technically true that all the Unknown Ores came from Yuan, since many were collected as a squad, there was no denying that Yuan was involved in all of them.
He silently stared at the Unknown Ores, wondering how he should tackle this situation.
However, before Yuan could say anything, another individual retrieved a second spatial cube and emptied its contents onto the floor, revealing another pile of glistening crystals.
This time, however, they were Unknown Crystals.
"These Unknown Crystals are affected by the same phenomenon, and they were also collected by you, Sergeant Yuan."
"Well? What do you have to say for yourself?"
"Let's stop wasting time and reveal how you extracted their energy without the use of specialized equipment!" one of them shouted as he slammed the desk.
"Why are you staying silent? We can take that as an admission of guilt."
Yuan closed his eyes and took a deep breathe, looking as though he was prepared to reveal the truth.
Then, he spoke, "I'm staying silent because I didn't want to waste my breath."
"What?"
They frowned at his words.
"You already said that you wouldn't believe me, so why even bother?"
"So you're telling us that this is all just a huge coincidence and that you're not responsible for it?"
Yuan quietly nodded his head, leaving them speechless, as they really expected him to give in after showing him so much evidence.

"Listen carefully. I don't know how you managed to do it, but this is a national-level security issue that goes far beyond this city! If the other cities discover that there's a way to extract Limitless from Unknown Ores and Crystals without using any machinery, they'll do everything in their power to obtain that method!"
"Then I don't see the issue, since I can't extract Limitless from them," Yuan calmly said.
Although his words might have sounded like a lie, he was actually telling the truth. What he extracted from the Unknown Ores and Crystals wasn't Limitless, but Eternal Essence.
"You—!
Just as one of the white-suited individuals opened their mouth to speak, another voice resounded from outside.
"W-Wait! You can't go inside, General—!"
Bang!
The door suddenly swung open, and two individuals walked into the room.
"General Mei? Ironwoman? What are the two of you doing here?"
"I think you know very well why I am here," Mei Feng responded with a slight frown on her face.
"Even if you're a General, you cannot just barge into this facility as if you own it, General Mei. Also, we have full authority to arrest someone."
"This isn't his first time being targeted, so I am just doing my due diligence," Mei Feng said. "If you have a valid reason for arresting him, I will not intervene."
She scanned the room, trying to understand the situation, but it only left her more puzzled.
"They think I can extract Limitless from Unknown Ores and Crystals," Yuan suddenly spoke, revealing the reason they arrested him.
"What?" Mei Feng frowned after hearing these words, turning to look at the group of individuals with a questioning gaze.

"Despite their flawless appearance, all of the Unknown Ores and Unknown Crystals you see in this room lack energy, and it started happening ever since his appearance. Moreover, they were all collected by him—or rather, he was involved in all of them," elaborated one of the individuals.
"When did this start happening? And how come this is my first time hearing about this?" Mei Feng then asked.
"We started noticing it shortly after Sergeant Yuan went on his first gathering mission, so about a year ago. As for why we've kept this a secret until now... We were simply gathering more evidence."
After a moment of silence, Mei Feng turned to look at Yuan and asked, "What do you have to say for yourself?"
Although Yuan could simply continue denying it, there was one issue. The Ironwoman had watched him collect Unknown Ores in the Black Zone and likely already knew the truth.
Eventually, Yuan let out a defeated sigh and said, "This might require me to reveal my... You know what. Should I still tell them?"

Mei Feng fell silent for another moment before nodding. "It's not like we can keep it hidden forever. We're bound to reveal it sooner or later anyway. Moreover, this situation is much more serious than you think."

Yuan nodded and revealed, "This is just a hypothesis, but because of my physique, my body automatically absorbs the energy within Unknown Ores and Unknown Crystals whenever I touch them. Unfortunately, it's not something I can control.
"What sort of nonsense is that?"
The people in white swiftly remarked with doubtful expressions.
"He has the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique," Mei Feng revealed.
"What?!"
Not just the people in white, but even the Ironwoman exclaimed in shock after hearing this.
"B-But we saw his information!"
"I had it concealed for obvious reasons."
The room fell silent as everyone there turned to look at Yuan with dumbfounded faces.
"H-How is that even possible? He's only at the Fifth Ascension!"
"I was born with it," Yuan calmly lied.

After a long minute of silence, one of them spoke, "We will need to confirm two things. One, that you really have the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique, and two, that you can absorb the energy of Unknown Ores that you touch."
"Fine by me." Yuan easily agreed.
Some time later, they brought a capsule-shaped machine into the room and instructed Yuan to enter it.
However, this was no ordinary machine. Only individuals with the highest Credential Ranks could operate it, and it revealed virtually everything.
[Physique: Perfected Heavenly Refinement]
"I-It's true! He really has the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique!"
"This is the first confirmed Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique in history!"
"Perfected Heavenly Refinement, huh?" Ironwoman mumbled in a low voice as she begun to understand the reason behind Yuan's unfathomable talents and capabilities.
A few minutes later, they moved on to the second test and handed Yuan an Unknown Ore and Unknown Crystal that still had all of its energy.
