chapters.title: Chapter 2681 The Impersonator(3)
paragraphs: "Your physique?! What kind of nonsense is that? If you're going to make things up, at least make it believable!" the Ember City representative shouted, his face full of doubt.
"I have the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique," Yuan revealed without hesitation.

Although General Mei had warned him to keep this matter a secret to avoid unnecessary complications, that was before he became suspected of being a Void Specter. At this point, there was hardly anything he could say that would make the situation any worse.

"Perfected Heavenly Refinement?! Did you just say you possess the Perfected Heavenly Refinement Physique?!" the representative from Jade City exclaimed as he shot to his feet, disbelief written all over his face.
Yuan calmly nodded.
"I can prove it if you want."
"There's no need," Supreme General Tian said. "It would take too much time to bring an evaluation machine here, and besides, it isn't necessary. I can personally vouch for it."
The other representatives immediately began murmuring among themselves, clearly taken aback by the unexpected revelation.
"If that's true, then this would be the first known appearance of someone possessing the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique."
"Supreme General Tian wouldn't lie about something that can easily be verified, so it must be true."
"Does this mean that in order to even have a chance of defeating the Void Hunter, one must possess the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique?"
"If that is the case, that means he might be the only person in this world who can defeat it..."
When the representative from Ember City heard the others talking and realized the discussion was beginning to drift away from the purpose of the assembly, he quickly raised his voice.
"W-Wait! The recording isn't finished yet! I saved the most important part for last!"
"What? You said yourself just a few minutes ago that the rest of the recording was irrelevant!" Supreme General Tian remarked with a frown.
However, the Ember City representative ignored him and said, "If this doesn't prove he's not human, then I don't know what will!"
He resumed the recording, revealing the rest of Yuan's battle with the Void Hunter. Naturally, the footage had been sped up, as watching the entire fight in real time would have taken several weeks.

The footage showed Yuan being brutally beaten by the Void Hunter, suffering countless fatal injuries that would have killed anyone else. At various points, he was decapitated, torn into several pieces, and even blown to smithereens.

"Are you all seeing what I'm seeing?! Even if he truly possesses the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique, there's no way it should be capable of something like this! Hell, even Tian Yuchen—the strongest cultivator in history and someone who possessed the Invincible Heavenly Refinement—never demonstrated regenerative abilities anywhere near this level!" the representative from Ember City exclaimed.
After taking a deep breath, he quickly continued, "The reason his body can regenerate like that is because he doesn't possess a true physical body at all—just like a Void Specter!"
Yuan responded to the accusation, "If I don't have a physical body, then how am I bleeding at all? Void Specters don't bleed."
"How the hell am I supposed to know? For all I know, that could simply be another one of your abilities!"
"Then..." Yuan paused for a brief second before asking, "Are Void Specters also capable of using Gaia's System?"
"W-What...?" the representative from Ember City muttered, a dumbfounded expression on his face.

The rest of the chamber also fell silent as everyone came to the same realization. Gaia's System had become such an ingrained part of their lives that none of them had even thought to use it to verify whether Yuan was truly human or a Void Specter.

After racking his brain for something to say, the representative from Ember City finally spoke. "W-We can't say for certain that a Void Specter is incapable of using Gaia's System, since we've never actually tested—"
"Cut the bullshit already," the representative from Heavenly Furnace interrupted. "Do you even hear yourself right now?"
"You—!" The representative from Ember City tried to respond, but another representative swiftly interrupted him.
"Enough is enough. I don't know why you're so obsessed with insisting that he's a Void Specter, but he's clearly human."
"Let's just end this with a vote," said Jade City's representative. "If you think that man is human, raise your hand."
Everyone but the Ember City representative raised their hand.
"If you think he's a Void Specter, raise your hand."
Since not everyone had voted, the vote continued.
However, the representative from Ember City still did not raise his hand, merely standing there with a bitter expression as though he were the one who had been wronged.
"It seems Ember City can't make up its mind, so let's just end it here," Supreme General Tian said.
The others nodded in agreement.

"But let's not end the assembly just yet," Jade City's representative said with a faint smile. "Since we're already here, we might as well discuss the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique. Surely you weren't expecting us to leave without addressing such an important matter, were you, Supreme General Tian?"
Supreme General Tian did not respond, merely letting out an annoyed snort.
"How long were you planning to keep this information from us, Supreme General Tian?" asked Eastern Dawn's representative.

"I understand that we're all rivals here, but some information should be shared with everyone—especially if it could help us defeat the Void Hunter. In fact, I'd even argue that you had a moral obligation to disclose it."

Supreme General Tian shrugged and said, "You probably won't believe me, but I already planned on sharing it. It's just that I didn't learn about it until shortly after the assembly was announced, so I figured I would reveal it at the assembly."
Although many of the representatives didn't believe him, none voiced their doubts and instead remained silent.
"So, what is there to discuss?" Supreme General Tian asked a moment later.
"For starters, how he managed to achieve that physique," said Jade City's representative. "If we can replicate his success, we can build an army to fight the Void Hunter."

chapters.title: Chapter 2682 End of the Assembly
paragraphs: When the others heard the representative from Jade City's question, they subconsciously clenched their fists in anticipation. For the first time in history, the secret to achieving the Perfected Heavenly Refinement was finally about to be revealed.
They turned to look at Yuan, quietly waiting for him to reveal it.
Seeing this, Yuan shook his head and said, "Sorry, but I was born with this physique."
"What?!"
The representatives widened their eyes in disbelief.

"That can't be! You're lying to us because you want to keep the secret to yourself!" the representative from Jade City exclaimed, refusing to believe that Yuan had been born with such a legendary physique.
Yuan shrugged and replied to such an accusation, "Take a look at my cultivation. I'm still in the Fifth Ascension. If I wasn't born with this physique, would my cultivation be so low?"

"What he's saying does make sense," the representative from Mirage City said. "Perhaps the reason no one has ever discovered a method to attain the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique is simply because no such method exists. Maybe the only way to possess it is to be born with it."

Although that was the most logical explanation, it was still difficult for the others to accept. If true, it meant that Yuan—or more precisely, Gaia's Heaven—would be the only power in possession of the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique.

Considering that Gaia's Heaven was already at the top in terms of strength and influence, this revelation would only widen the gap between it and the other cities even further, especially when the others are aware of Yuan's capabilities from the recording.
"So, what should we do about this situation?" someone suddenly asked.

"While his cultivation is nowhere near Tian Yuchen's level when he became independent and factionless, I believe he should still be treated in a similar manner, especially since he is the only person capable of fighting the Void Hunter right now," said the representative from Rising Sun.
"I agree with Rising City that he shouldn't be tied to Gaia's Heaven."
"But he's only at the Fifth Ascension. He's still too immature to be independent," said the representative of Cloudpiercer.
"Then we can all share the responsibility of strengthening him. That way, no one can claim they contributed more effort or resources than anyone else."
Yuan raised an eyebrow as he listened to the representatives discuss his future as though they already owned him and had every right to decide for him.
"Now wait a minute." Yuan finally spoke, unable to listen any longer. "Who are you to decide what I'm going to do—or whether I become an independent power in the first place?"
His words immediately silenced the room, and everyone turned to look at him with raised eyebrows, looking like they'd just heard something puzzling.
Yuan continued, "I'm not going to be trained by any of you, and I certainly have no intention of leaving Gaia's Heaven to become an independent power like Tian Yuchen."

The representative from Jade City then spoke. "I don't think you understand the situation. You're the only person in this world capable of defeating the Void Hunter, which poses a threat to all of humanity—"

"So what?" Yuan coldly interrupted. "That doesn't give you the right to control me. If you want me to defeat the Void Hunter, then it would be in your best interest to serve me—not the other way around."
"You have a moral obligation to defeat the Void Hunter as a human!" the representative from Ember City exclaimed.
Yuan turned to look at him with a disdainful smile. "Weren't you just calling me a Void Specter?"

"T-That's beside the point! If you're a real human, you wouldn't have any issue fighting for us—as one of us! If you refuse, you're definitely a Void Specter, and nothing you say will change my mind!"

Of course, Yuan already intended to defeat the Void Hunter even without their urging. What bothered him was how they treated him like nothing more than a tool, and it made him want to defy their wishes.
Meanwhile, Supreme General Tian remained completely silent, merely observing Yuan as though he wanted to see how he would handle the situation on his own.

"If you don't wish to become independent, that's fine. However, don't forget that Tian Yuchen chose independence for a reason. Not even the strongest cultivator in the world can stop a war by himself," the representative from Jade City said, essentially threatening war.
Yuan burst out laughing.
"So you'll go to war with Gaia's Heaven if I refuse your demands? Hahaha! Go ahead!"
Everyone there were baffled by Yuan's response, including Supreme General Tian.
"Are you saying you don't care what happens to Gaia's Heaven?" one of the representatives asked with a frown.

A cold expression settled over Yuan's face as he replied in a chilling voice, "No. I'm saying that if you want to attack Gaia's Heaven, then go ahead. But understand this—if anything happens to Gaia's Heaven, you can forget about me ever defeating the Void Hunter, even if that means letting it wipe humanity out entirely."
"You can't be serious!"
The representative from Eastern Dawn slammed the table in disbelief.
"If you don't believe me, then feel free to test me," Yuan replied coldly.
The people in the chamber stared into Yuan's eyes, yet not one of them could detect even the slightest hint of hesitation or deceit.
If anything, they became convinced that Yuan truly wouldn't hesitate to let humanity perish.
"I-I knew it... You're not human!" the representative from Ember City muttered, terror creeping into his expression.

He pointed at Yuan and continued speaking while looking at the others, "We should kill him now! If he refuses to defeat the Void Hunter, then he's essentially useless to us! Moreover, there's still a chance that someone else will eventually be born with the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique! It's not like we're facing any imminent danger either, so we have plenty of time to wait for someone else capable of defeating the Void Hunter to appear!"
"Kill me?" Yuan chuckled.
"What the hell is so funny?! You think you're invincible?!"
"Attack me, and you'll find out," said Yuan with a provocative smile.
As the atmosphere grew increasingly tense, Supreme General Tian finally spoke.
"Enough."

"Well, what do you think should happen, Supreme General Tian?" The Spirit City representative asked him. "Even if he doesn't want to leave Gaia's Heaven, you have the authority to exile him from the city, forcing him to become independent."

Supreme General Tian sneered. "When my grandfather, Tian Yuchen, chose to become independent, he did so of his own accord. Even if I have the authority to exile him, I don't have the right to tell him to risk his life and fight the Void Hunter. And as the footage we all just watched clearly showed, he is still too weak to defeat the Void Hunter."
He then turned to Yuan and asked, "What do you want to do now?"
Yuan remained silent for a moment before replying, "Right now? After being treated like some kind of tool by everyone here, I don't feel like doing anything—especially not defeating the Void Hunter."

After a brief pause, he continued, "However, if I'm allowed to live my life the way I want without anyone trying to control or influence me, then perhaps I'll feel like taking on the Void Hunter someday. After all, I have a debt to settle with it after such a humiliating defeat."
Supreme General Tian then said, "Well, you've all heard him. I have nothing more to add on that matter."

He paused to take a deep breath before continuing, "Now that that's settled, let me address something else. If any of you think I'll sit here and allow Gaia's Heaven to be threatened, then you clearly don't know me at all. Regardless of the circumstances, if anyone dares to attack Gaia's Heaven, we will retaliate with everything we have."
The chamber fell silent after that, and several minutes passed before someone finally broke the silence.

"Since this is an unprecedented situation, especially considering how suddenly all of this was revealed, I think we should return to our respective cities and take some time to think it over before discussing it again at the next assembly."
The representative from Spirit City then continued, "Two years. How about we schedule the next assembly for exactly two years from now and continue this matter then?"
"I agree," said Heavenly Furnace's representative.
"Me too."
One by one, the other cities agreed. Ember City, however, remained silent.
"Then we'll meet again in two years. Until then."

The representative from Spirit City did not linger and immediately left the chamber with his people. The others soon followed, not bothering to wait for Ember City's response, as an assembly only required the participation of at least five cities to take place.
Soon, only Gaia's Heaven and Ember City remained in the chamber.

"You may have managed to fool the others, but you won't fool me, you Void Specter!" the representative from Ember City shouted, pointing accusingly at Yuan before storming out of the chamber with his people.
Shortly after, Gaia's Heaven also left.
"We're leaving immediately. Pack your things and assemble here in fifteen minutes," Supreme General Tian said once they returned to their residential area.
"Yes!"
"Also, you are all prohibited from revealing anything that was discussed at the assembly today to anyone, even if they are your superior," he suddenly said.
"As for General Mei and General Gu, I will be briefing them myself."

chapters.title: Chapter 2683 Returning to Gaia's Heaven
paragraphs: Fifteen minutes later, Yuan and the others returned to the gathering point, prepared to leave the Union.
After a quick headcount to ensure everyone was accounted for, they boarded the flying treasure and departed from the Union. Naturally, Major Gu was still nowhere to be seen.
Once they were a few hours away from the Union, Supreme General Tian called Yuan into his office.
"I only have one question for you. Is it really true that you were born with the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique?" Supreme General Tian asked as soon as Yuan closed the door.
"If you're asking whether it's possible for someone else to possess the Perfected Heavenly Refinement Physique... I don't think so." Yuan shook his head.
"So you weren't born with it?" Supreme General Tian frowned. "I don't care if everything you say after this is a lie. For this one question, just tell me the truth."

Yuan remained silent for a moment before responding in a serious voice, "No, I wasn't. To achieve the Perfected Heavenly Refinement, one must temper their body to the absolute limit—no, even beyond that. And quite frankly, I don't believe the process can be replicated in this world."
Supreme General Tian fell silent with a pondering expression on his face.
He mumbled out loud a few moments later, "In other words, you really are the only person in this world who has a chance to defeat the Void Hunter..."

"Is it really necessary to defeat it? The Void Hunter only appears outside the city walls, and it doesn't even make an appearance unless there are ten or more people in close proximity." Yuan then asked.

Supreme General Tian gazed into his eyes and responded solemnly, "It may not pose an immediate threat, but we can't say for certain that things will remain that way forever. And even if they do, it would still be in our best interest to eliminate the Void Hunter. Its existence is the main reason we're unable to expand our territory and are forced to remain confined within the cities, living almost like prisoners."
"Things may be manageable for now, but as our population continues to grow, so will our demand for resources, and that will inevitably require us to expand into more land."
Supreme General Tian fell silent again, but his gaze remained fixated on Yuan.

Eventually, he spoke again, asking Yuan in a somewhat nervous voice, "Do you have any intention of defeating—fighting the Void Hunter again? Honestly, I wouldn't blame you for not wanting to fight that monster."
"That will depend on how the others choose to act," Yuan answered truthfully.
"What if I told you that even if the other cities were to destroy Gaia's Heaven, I would still want you to defeat the Void Hunter?"

Yuan shrugged. "Sorry to disappoint you, but I'm a rather petty and selfish person, and I'm certainly no hero. But as long as they don't try to force things down my throat, I'll deal with the Void Hunter."
"Very well... And while you're still being truthful, why don't you tell me the truth behind Major Gu's disappearance?"
Supreme General Tian expected to hear something different, but alas, Yuan remained adamant that he had nothing to do with Major Gu's disappearance.
"I really have nothing to do with Major Gu's disappearance."
"...If you insist."
Supreme General Tian sent Yuan out shortly after, before summoning Ironwoman next.
"Don't think I've forgotten about you," Supreme General Tian said. "Tell me why you were mentioned in the footage."
Ironwoman let out a quiet sigh before revealing the truth.

"It happened during Sergeant Yuan's incident with the Scorpion Squad. I actually found him in the Black Zone before the Scorpion Squad returned to the city. However, he asked me to keep our encounter a secret. After spending some time with him, I returned to the city and pretended we had never met."
"You know I could still get you into serious trouble for that, right?" Supreme General Tian said with a slight frown.
"If you truly intend to punish me for what I did, I won't complain. I was fully aware of the consequences when I made that decision."

After a moment of silence, Supreme General Tian spoke. "Fortunately for you, I already have enough on my plate, so I'll overlook it for now. However, there's still a chance that Colonel Gu will report everything that happened at the assembly to General Gu despite my warning. If General Gu decides to pursue this matter, I won't be able to protect you."
Ironwoman smiled behind her mask and said, "General Gu will be too busy with someone else to come after me."

Time passed, and once everyone returned to their respective cities, news of Yuan's existence spread like wildfire. In no time, his name became one of the most recognizable in the world. Not only was he the first known person to possess the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique, but he was also revealed to be the one who had fought the Void Hunter for weeks not long ago.

"Breaking news! Breaking news! The first person to possess the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique has appeared, and he might also be the only person in this world who could defeat the Void Hunter!"

However, not every city was spreading Yuan's name like gospel. In fact, Gaia's Heaven—and Gaia's Heaven alone—remained largely unchanged, as Yuan's identity was not publicized throughout the city and continued to be kept secret for the time being.
Once they returned to the city, Supreme General Tian immediately summoned General Gu and General Mei to his office and revealed the situation.
"T-The Perfected Heavenly Refinement...?" General Gu wore a baffled expression on his face after hearing the news, his complexion turning as pale as a ghost's.
Meanwhile, General Mei was left speechless for other reasons.

'Not only has his physique been revealed to the entire world, but the fact that he can fight the Void Hunter has spread as well! This is the worst possible outcome!' she cried inwardly, dread creeping into her heart as she thought about what the future might bring.

sentences.text: Fifteen minutes later, Yuan and the others returned to the gathering point, prepared to leave the Union.
After a quick headcount to ensure everyone was accounted for, they boarded the flying treasure and departed from the Union.
Naturally, Major Gu was still nowhere to be seen.
Once they were a few hours away from the Union, Supreme General Tian called Yuan into his office.
"I only have one question for you.
Is it really true that you were born with the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique?" Supreme General Tian asked as soon as Yuan closed the door.
"If you're asking whether it's possible for someone else to possess the Perfected Heavenly Refinement Physique...
I don't think so." Yuan shook his head.
"So you weren't born with it?" Supreme General Tian frowned.
"I don't care if everything you say after this is a lie.
For this one question, just tell me the truth."
Yuan remained silent for a moment before responding in a serious voice, "No, I wasn't.
To achieve the Perfected Heavenly Refinement, one must temper their body to the absolute limit—no, even beyond that.
And quite frankly, I don't believe the process can be replicated in this world."
Supreme General Tian fell silent with a pondering expression on his face.
He mumbled out loud a few moments later, "In other words, you really are the only person in this world who has a chance to defeat the Void Hunter..."
"Is it really necessary to defeat it?
The Void Hunter only appears outside the city walls, and it doesn't even make an appearance unless there are ten or more people in close proximity." Yuan then asked.
Supreme General Tian gazed into his eyes and responded solemnly, "It may not pose an immediate threat, but we can't say for certain that things will remain that way forever.
And even if they do, it would still be in our best interest to eliminate the Void Hunter.
Its existence is the main reason we're unable to expand our territory and are forced to remain confined within the cities, living almost like prisoners."
"Things may be manageable for now, but as our population continues to grow, so will our demand for resources, and that will inevitably require us to expand into more land."
Supreme General Tian fell silent again, but his gaze remained fixated on Yuan.
Eventually, he spoke again, asking Yuan in a somewhat nervous voice, "Do you have any intention of defeating—fighting the Void Hunter again?
Honestly, I wouldn't blame you for not wanting to fight that monster."
"That will depend on how the others choose to act," Yuan answered truthfully.
"What if I told you that even if the other cities were to destroy Gaia's Heaven, I would still want you to defeat the Void Hunter?"
Yuan shrugged.
"Sorry to disappoint you, but I'm a rather petty and selfish person, and I'm certainly no hero.
But as long as they don't try to force things down my throat, I'll deal with the Void Hunter."
"Very well...
And while you're still being truthful, why don't you tell me the truth behind Major Gu's disappearance?"
Supreme General Tian expected to hear something different, but alas, Yuan remained adamant that he had nothing to do with Major Gu's disappearance.
"I really have nothing to do with Major Gu's disappearance."
"...If you insist."
Supreme General Tian sent Yuan out shortly after, before summoning Ironwoman next.
"Don't think I've forgotten about you," Supreme General Tian said.
"Tell me why you were mentioned in the footage."
Ironwoman let out a quiet sigh before revealing the truth.
"It happened during Sergeant Yuan's incident with the Scorpion Squad.
I actually found him in the Black Zone before the Scorpion Squad returned to the city.
However, he asked me to keep our encounter a secret.
After spending some time with him, I returned to the city and pretended we had never met."
"You know I could still get you into serious trouble for that, right?" Supreme General Tian said with a slight frown.
"If you truly intend to punish me for what I did, I won't complain.
I was fully aware of the consequences when I made that decision."
After a moment of silence, Supreme General Tian spoke.
"Fortunately for you, I already have enough on my plate, so I'll overlook it for now.
However, there's still a chance that Colonel Gu will report everything that happened at the assembly to General Gu despite my warning.
If General Gu decides to pursue this matter, I won't be able to protect you."
Ironwoman smiled behind her mask and said, "General Gu will be too busy with someone else to come after me."

chapters.title: Chapter 2684 Returning to Gaia's Heaven(2)
paragraphs: Seeing the generals' reactions, Supreme General Tian spoke. "Although things are looking grim, it could have been much worse."
"What could possibly be worse than this?!" Mei Feng exclaimed.

"Many things, actually. The other cities could have doubled down and demanded that Sergeant Yuan become independent. The situation could have easily escalated into war, especially with Ember City. Quite frankly, it's a miracle we managed to return to the city safe and sound."

"With that said, it's not as though we've completely avoided any of those possibilities. We all—well, most of us—agreed to postpone the matter until the next assembly, which has already been scheduled for two years from now."
"That doesn't sound reassuring at all..." Mei Feng sighed.
"It wasn't meant to reassure you," Supreme General Tian said, shaking his head.
"So, what are we going to do from now on? Prepare for war?" Mei Feng asked.

"As long as Sergeant Yuan remains the only person who possesses the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique and the other cities want the Void Hunter eliminated, I don't believe they'll dare to attack us—especially after Sergeant Yuan made it clear that he would refuse to deal with the Void Hunter if anything happened to Gaia's Heaven."
"What are the chances of Sergeant Yuan actually being able to defeat the Void Hunter?" Mei Feng suddenly asked.

"If we judge solely based on the footage I saw, then right now, he has no chance of defeating it. However, I'm well aware of his talent and how quickly he grows. If he continues progressing at this rate, there's a very real possibility that he'll become capable of defeating the Void Hunter in the future."
"Unfortunately, whether the other cities are capable of controlling themselves before then is very questionable."
After a brief pause, Supreme General Tian spoke. "Anyway, to answer your earlier question, our priority right now is to ensure Sergeant Yuan's safety and help him grow stronger."

He then turned to General Gu and continued, "I'm willing to turn a blind eye to everything that has happened so far. But if you continue targeting him, you'll have to answer to me—not as the Supreme General, but as the head of the Tian Family. Do I make myself clear?"

General Gu silently nodded in a daze, almost as though the gesture had been purely instinctive. Whether he had actually heard Supreme General Tian's warning—or agreed with it—was another matter entirely.
A moment later, Supreme General Tian turned to Mei Feng and said, "Since you've been looking after him since the beginning, I'll leave him in your care and let you continue overseeing his affairs.
Mei Feng shook her head and sighed.
"If you don't want to deal with him, just say so... I know he can be a handful, but it's really not that bad once you get used to it."

Supreme General Tian stood up and said one last thing before leaving. "For now, we'll keep the situation under wraps. Once I've spoken with 'her' and heard her thoughts on the matter, I'll let you know the next steps. Dismissed."
Mei Feng did not linger, but before leaving, she glanced at General Gu and said, "As stubborn as you are, I doubt even you'd be foolish enough to keep going after him now."
General Gu remained seated in the room long after Supreme General Tian and Mei Feng left, a dazed look still lingering on his face.
"It's over..." he mumbled in a defeated voice.
However, the next moment, the phone in his pocket suddenly vibrated with an incoming message.
The moment he read it, his eyes widened, and he hurriedly left the room.
Some time later, General Gu met up with Colonel Gu, who had sent him the message earlier.
"What happened to my little brother, Gu Ming?!" General Gu grabbed Colonel Gu by the collar and asked loudly.
"I don't know what exactly happened to him, but he's disappeared completely, and I am certain that bastard Sergeant Yuan had something to do with it!"
"Tell me everything that happened!"
Colonel Gu nodded and began explaining everything to General Gu, starting from when they hired the Angry Shadows to assassinate Yuan and ending with his own attempt to finish the job personally.
"After waiting for several hours, I eventually gave up and returned to my residence. But Gu Ming, who was still inside the house when I left, had vanished without a trace!
"I don't know how he did it, but that bastard must've snuck into our residence and done something to Gu Ming while I was waiting for his return!"

After a moment of silence, General Gu sighed. "And what exactly do you expect me to do? He now has the Supreme General's backing. As powerful as our Gu Family may be, we are still beneath the Tian Family. Not to mention, the other cities will be keeping a close eye on him as well."
Colonel Gu fell silent for a moment, deep in thought, before his eyes suddenly flickered.
"Ember City! I'm sure you already know this, but they seem particularly eager to see that bastard dead. We can use their help to get rid of him!"
General Gu's eyes also began flickering after hearing this.
'Now that I think about it, we have some connection in Ember City!' he smiled inwardly after realizing this.
At the same time, Yuan entered Mei Feng's office after being called by her.
"If you're going to yell at me for—" Yuan spoke the moment he opened the door to her office.
"And waste my breath? I save it for next time," Mei Feng interrupted. "I want to know more about your training method and how you can grow stronger."
"Oh?" Yuan muttered with a somewhat surprised expression.

"Now that your existence has been exposed to the world, you can no longer live a normal life. And if you don't want others controlling your fate, you'll need to grow stronger—much stronger. Of course, this is also for this city's sake. So tell me, how can we help you become stronger?" Mei Feng asked with a serious expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 2685 47th Floor
paragraphs: Yuan pondered Mei Feng's question for a moment before responding, "Quite frankly, I don't think there's anything the military can do to help me train. Although I can grow stronger by absorbing the energy within Unknown Ores and Unknown Crystals, the amount I need to see any significant improvement is tremendous, and I doubt you'll be able to provide me with unlimited resources."
Mei Feng quickly responded, "How many do you need? If it's a few thousand—"
"A few million," Yuan immediately replied.
Mei Feng's expression changed upon hearing such an astronomical number.
"Do you have any idea how long the city could survive on that many resources?"
Yuan merely shrugged.
"I don't. But that's exactly why I said the military wouldn't be able to support me." He paused for a moment before continuing, "You know what you can do to help me, though?"
"What is it?"
"Allow me to enter level 2 Black Zone. Even better if it's level 3."
Mei Feng replied with a frown, "You know we're supposed to ensure your safety, not send you to your death, right? The military will never allow you to venture into such a dangerous place."

"Sorry, but this is non-negotiable," Yuan said resolutely. "If you want me to grow stronger quickly, you'll have to let me go to places like that. In fact, the more dangerous the place, the faster I'll improve. If you're really that worried, you can send a few people to guard me, but honestly, you'd just be risking their lives for no reason."
After another moment of silence, Mei Feng spoke, "I'll speak with the Supreme General and see what he has to say first."
"In the meantime, I would like to take some leave."
"Leave? What are you planning to do with it? And how long do you intend to be gone?" Mei Feng asked. After all, requesting leave was essentially the same as asking for a vacation.
"I'm going to spend it at Gaia's Sanctum. I don't know how long I'll stay there, though, but it definitely won't be very long."
"In that case, there's no need for you to take leave, as every soldier is permitted to visit Gaia's Sanctum as they please."
"Really? Why didn't anybody tell me that? I would've gone much earlier if I knew."
"You never asked."
"Then I'll go to Gaia's Sanctum later today."
"There is something you should know before going," Mei Feng quickly said. "You are not allowed to use military techniques, such as Void Control, in Gaia's Sanctum."
"I am aware."
"Good. Then try not to cause any trouble.
"I will. Also, about my credentials..."
"I'll talk to the Supreme General about that, too."
"Alright."
Yuan left shortly after, but as he left, he encountered Mei Xiaoyun.
"You're back? How was the assembly?" she asked.
"It was troublesome."
"Really?"
"Unfortunately, I cannot talk about it."
"I know."
"What have you been doing these days?" Yuan then asked.
"Same as usual. Training."
"In that case, do you want to visit Gaia's Sanctum with me like before? I'm going there right now."
Mei Xiaoyun shook her head and said, "Since we cannot use Void Control there, I'll continue training here."
"Then how about a few training sessions with me? I'm not in a hurry to leave, anyway."
"Are you sure?"
He nodded.
"Then I'll bother you for a bit."
Thus, Yuan decided to delay his visit to Gaia's Sanctum for a few days to train Mei Xiaoyun by taking her into the void.
Meanwhile, the Supreme General sat in a small room with another individual—a black-haired woman.
"And that's the situation now. What do you think we should do with him?"

After a long moment of silence, the woman wondered aloud, "So he can survive the Void Hunter's death touch because of his Perfected Heavenly Refinement, huh? Makes one wonder if he can survive an ordinary Void Specter's touch, too."
"Before I express my thoughts, what do you think we should do, Supreme General?"
"Honestly, I have no clue." Supreme General Tian sighed. "This is an unprecedented situation, and that fellow even claims to be from another world."
"Another world..."
"Not only that, but he... he said that his goal was to meet Gaia."
"Oh?
"Do you still think it's a good idea to meet him? While I don't believe he's dangerous, there are simply too many questionable things surrounding his existence."
"As long as he's not dangerous, I don't see any reasons not to. That being said, I will still wait a little longer before I make a decision."

After a brief pause, she continued, "As for what we should do... let's wait and see how the other cities react first. I doubt they'll simply sit still and do nothing over the next two years. If possible, I'd rather not act too rashly and risk starting a war with another city."
"What about Sergeant Yuan?"
"Continue monitoring him for now, too."
"I understand."
A week later, Yuan finished his training with Mei Xiaoyun and set out for Gaia's Sanctum.
The moment he arrived at Gaia's Sanctum, Yuan entered Endless Assault and challenged the 46th floor.
"Foolish mortal..."
Of course, Yuan made short work of it, defeating it in a new personal-best time of 9 seconds.
<You have cleared the 46th Floor>
<You have received 250,000 Gaia Points as a reward>
<You have received Limitless as a reward>
<Your cultivation has reached First Level Sixth Ascension>
<You have received Eternal Essence>
<Proceed to the 47th floor?>
"Hm?"
Yuan was surprised when he received Eternal Essence as a reward for the first time, and it was not a small amount.
"That was about a trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence!"
This unexpected reward made him even more motivated to climb the floors.
Yet, even with this increase in Eternal Essence, Yuan did not dare grow complacent and cautiously entered the 47th floor.

The moment he stepped inside, the scenery changed completely. The endless, empty arena was gone, replaced by a vast grassy landscape beneath a beautiful sky painted in shades of orange and red. Even the air carried a fresh scent, almost as if he were really out in the wilderness.
However, the peaceful atmosphere did not last long. A moment later, an overwhelming presence several times stronger than the entity on the 46th floor engulfed the entire area.

chapters.title: Chapter 2686 48th Floor
paragraphs: 'What a tremendous presence! It almost rivals the Void Hunter from when I fought it!' Yuan cried inwardly after sensing the overwhelming aura.
The next moment, the owner of that presence appeared before him, and to Yuan's surprise, it also took the form of the Void Hunter.
Shortly after appearing, the Void Hunter made its first move.
Yuan expected it to try to kill him immediately, just like the entity on the 46th floor had. Instead, however, it closed the distance and engaged him in close combat.
'Is this just a coincidence, or is it preparing for my fight with the real Void Hunter?' Yuan wondered to himself as he fought the fake Void Hunter.
The battle lasted for several hours before Yuan inevitably fell to the Void Hunter. Despite his defeat, however, he was confident that he could overcome it.
After taking some time to review his fight with the Void Hunter in the waiting room, Yuan went in for the second attempt.
Meanwhile, Supreme General Tian updated General Gu and Mei Feng on the situation through the phone.
"After speaking with her, we've decided to see how the others react first. Any questions?"
"I have a few, but they're mostly regarding Sergeant Yuan."
"Meet me in my office in an hour," said the Supreme General.
"Okay."
An hour later, Mei Feng entered the Supreme General's office.
"So, what questions do you have?"
"As I said earlier, it's regarding Sergeant Yuan. I asked him how we could assist with his training, but he insisted that we wouldn't be able to."
Mei Feng elaborated on the situation with the Unknown Ores and Crystals.
"Instead, he wants us to let him go into level 2 Black Zone to train."
Supreme General Tian raised an eyebrow at Yuan's request and asked, "How does that help with his training?"
"I'm not too sure myself, but it has something to do with defeating Void Specters."
Supreme General Tian fell silent to ponder.
"If he wants to enter level 2 Black Zone, let him. Especially if it'll strengthen him."
"But didn't you say we should protect him? Sending him into a level 2 Black Zone sounds like the exact opposite of that."

Supreme General Tian chuckled before responding, "I don't blame you for worrying about him, but if you had seen his fight with the Void Hunter, you'd realize there's little reason to be concerned. When I said to protect him, I meant from the other cities."
"I understand..."
"Make sure you send a few capable soldiers with him, just in case."
"Actually, I already suggested that, but he said that would only put those soldiers at unnecessary risk."
Hearing this, Supreme General Tian recalled what the black-haired woman had said.
"So he knows that his Perfected Heavenly Refinement protects him not just from the Void Hunter, but from Void Specters as well, huh?"

"In that case, instead of sending soldiers to protect him, send them to monitor him. I'm willing to bet that guy is still hiding plenty of secrets, so we should observe him and learn as much as we can. There's no need to be discreet about it, either," Supreme General Tian said.
"In that case, why don't we just ask him?"
"Do you really think he'd be willing to tell us everything if we asked? It's not like we haven't questioned him, either."
Mei Feng sighed before responding, "That was before the assembly, but I guess you're right."
"Anything else?" Supreme General Tian then asked.
"Well, do you remember that incident when he was arrested by the Extactors? He was trying to increase his credentials before getting arrested, and he asked if he could increase his Credential Rank."
"Does he even realize that in order to increase his Credential Rank, he'd need to be trustworthy...?" Supreme General Tian shook his head.
"If you didn't know, Sergeant Yuan is actually afflicted by several powerful curses. I believe he's trying to remove them through Gaia's System, which requires him to reach certain Credential Ranks."
"I'm well aware."
Supreme General Tian fell silent with a pondering expression on his face.
Eventually, he spoke, "I'll approve it. Also, promote him to Captain. We can't let him wander as an ordinary soldier anymore."
Mei Feng nodded.
"I was already intending on doing that since he'd earned more than enough merit from the drill."
Their meeting ended shortly afterward.
At the same time, Yuan managed to defeat the Void Hunter on the 47th floor after 33 attempts.

<You have received 500,000 Gaia Points as a reward>
<You have received Limitless as a reward>
<Your cultivation has reached Fourth Level Sixth Ascension>
<You have received Eternal Essence>
<Proceed to the 48th floor?>
Yuan closed his eyes and enjoyed the feeling of his Eternal Essence skyrocketing by another two trillion years.
In just two floors, he'd managed to double his total Eternal Essence from three trillion years to six trillion years.
"I am now only four trillion years away from being able to fight Eternals..." he muttered.

Some time later, he proceeded to the 48th floor. Although he was well aware that he likely had no chance of defeating the 48th floor, he still wanted to see how big the difference was and how much he needed to improve before having a chance of clearing it.
Shortly after arriving on the 48th floor, an unfathomable presence descended on him, rivaling the real Void Hunter he'd fought.
"No... this Void Hunter even surpasses the one I fought!" Yuan swallowed nervously.
While it wasn't drastically stronger, the Void Hunter on the 48th floor was still far beyond what Yuan could hope to defeat at his current level.
In just a few minutes, Yuan was killed and sent back to the waiting room.

After the fight, he finally realized just how much the real Void Hunter had been holding back when they fought. Had it truly fought with the intent to kill, Yuan likely would have been defeated within minutes, and it was still barely using its true strength, considering that even Tian Yuchen, who cleared the 49th floor, couldn't defeat it.

chapters.title: Chapter 2687 Rank Two
paragraphs: Shortly after Yuan cleared the 46th floor, a commotion started in the lobby of Gaia's Sanctum when the people there noticed the rankings for Endless Assault had changed once again.
"H-He's moved up again! The unknown Player who cleared the 45th floor a little over a year ago has moved up the rankings after clearing the 46th floor!"
"He's in third place now, tied with second place!"
People began gathering at the rankings, quickly forming a large crowd.
"When did he clear the 46th floor?"
"About ten minutes ago."
"Do you think he'll attempt the 47th floor immediately?"

"Unlikely. According to those who have passed the 40th floor, the difficulty increases tremendously with each floor after that. It'll likely take a few more decades before he even has a chance to clear the 47th floor."
"Who the hell is this guy, anyway?"
"Nobody knows."
Similar conversations happened at the other Gaia's Sanctums, but the crowd quickly dispersed, as nobody there anticipated that Yuan would clear the 47th floor any time soon.
A few days later, however...
A passing Player who happened to glance at the ranking at the right time noticed that the Player who was ranked two had been pushed to third place by the unnamed Player!
"L-Look! That unknown Player has beaten the 47th floor, becoming rank two in Endless Assault!"
"What?!"
His words immediately halted everyone around him, causing them to rush to the rankings to see for themselves.
"Heavens! It's true! He's really ranked two now!"
"How's that possible?! It's only been two weeks since he cleared the 46th floor!"

While another crowd—one that was even bigger than the last—gathered at the rankings, Yuan left the waiting room and made his way to the exchange to spend his points, not even bothering to check the rankings, as it meant nothing in his eyes.
At the exchange, Yuan immediately purchased the final part of the Limitless Cultivation Technique, using all of the points he'd obtained from the 46th and 47th floors.
<Confirm Purchase of Limitless Cultivation Technique(4) for 750,000 Gaia Points>
<Confirmed>
<You have purchased Limitless Cultivation Technique(4)>
After purchasing the technique, Yuan turned his attention towards One Above All and Last Man Standing.
"Since I am already here, I might as well do my monthly limit. It won't take long, anyway," Yuan muttered to himself as he made his way to One Above All.
<You have won your match!>
<You are on a winning streak!>
<Win Streak: 501>
<You have earned 100 Gaia Points>
<You have received Limitless as a reward>
<You have earned 500 additional Gaia Points for your win streak>
<You have received bonus Limitless for your win streak>

Yuan's first match at the Grandmaster Rank went about just as well as he'd expected. Since his opponent wasn't in the military, they had no access to proper training, so it felt like no different from fighting a baby in his eyes.
Soon, Yuan finished his monthly limit, increasing his win streak by another hundred.
After leaving the waiting room, Yuan made his way toward Last Man Standing. However, before he could get far, a young man suddenly stepped into his path.
"Remember me, you bastard?" the young man asked with a cold grin.
Yuan lowered his gaze toward the young man, who stood nearly a full head shorter than him, and returned his smile.
"Of course, I do. You're that generous gentleman who donated 50 Gaia Points to a new Player like me. What do you want now? If you're looking for a rematch, I hope you have enough Gaia Points."
This young man was none other than Gu Kecheng.
"I have 50 Gaia Points! Let's fight! You won't be so arrogant after—"
"Only 50 points?" Yuan interrupted with a disappointed look on his face.
"Look here, 50 Gaia Points is literally nothing to me right now. If you want to fight me—to waste my time, you'll need at least 50,000 Gaia Points.

"F-Fifty thousand Gaia Points?! You're out of your damn mind! If you're too afraid to fight me, just admit it! There's no need for you to make such an unreasonable demand!" Gu Kecheng shouted while pointing at Yuan's face.
Yuan fell silent for a moment before speaking, "Your name was Gu Kecheng, right? Do you perhaps have family in the military?"
"Oh?"
Gu Kecheng's eyes lit up upon hearing Yuan's words.

"How did you know? Actually, never mind. You don't need to answer something so obvious. That's right—many of my family members are in the military. Not only that, but several of them hold high-ranking positions. One of them is even a General, the second-highest rank in the whole military!"
Yuan smiled and said, "You know, I recently joined the military myself, and I have become quite acquainted with the Gu Family in the military. Especially Major Gu."
"Major Gu...? You mean my uncle, Gu Ming? How close are you two?"
"Very close. We're essentially best friends."
"Really?" Gu Kecheng looked at Yuan with a suspicious gaze.
"Why would I lie to you? You can ask them later if you want. In any case, you wanted to fight, right? I'll fight with you, and I don't need any Gaia Points from you."
Despite Yuan's suspicious behavior, Gu Kecheng couldn't miss the opportunity to get his revenge.
However, as Gu Kecheng followed Yuan, he suddenly stopped and said, "Wait. You're in the military now, right? That means you've received military training!"

Yuan tilted his head and said, "While I did receive training, I've only just finished boot camp not long ago, and quite frankly, they didn't teach anything useful. Moreover, we're not allowed to use any military techniques in Gaia's Sanctum."
"That's..."
"How about this? If you can beat me, I'll give you five thousand Gaia Points."
"F-Five thousand?!"
Although Gu Kecheng thought it was a lot of points, he didn't really think too deeply about it and subconsciously nodded.
"Alright."
"I'll send you the challenge this time," Yuan said.
Some time later, they entered the waiting room, and Gu Kecheng waited for Yuan to challenge him.

chapters.title: Chapter 2688 Gu Kecheng
paragraphs: After waiting for a few minutes, Gu Kecheng received Yuan's challenge request.
<Player Yuan(Master) has sent you a match request for One Above All>
<Win Condition: 5,000 Gaia Points> <Lose Condition: N/A>
[Player Yuan]
[Cultivation: Fourth Level Sixth Ascension]
[One Above All: Grandmaster]
[One Above All Highest Win Streak: 600]
Gu Kecheng's eyes popped out of their sockets from shock and disbelief after he saw Yuan's stats.
"What the fuck is that?!" he cried out loud.

Gu Kecheng had managed to reach the rank of Warrior since his last custom match with Yuan, and he'd even received some private training from his family, which is why he felt confident. However, after seeing Yuan's stats for One Above All, that confidence shattered like fragile glass after being smashed by a massive rock.
"G-Grandmaster? Fourth Level Sixth Ascension? Six hundred win streak?! He'd grown that much in just a year?! That's impossible!" Gu Kecheng refused to believe it.
"I know! There must be a glitch in the system!"
After somehow convincing himself of that, Gu Kecheng accepted Yuan's challenge request.
<Match will begin in 10 seconds>
"Oh?"
A surprised smile appeared on Yuan's face when he saw that Gu Kecheng had accepted his challenge request.
Given his stats, he fully expected Gu Kecheng to decline. Yet, the opposite had happened.
<Your match will begin now>
<Teleporting to arena in 3...2..1...>
Once they were teleported to the arena, Yuan couldn't help but ask, "Hey, I have to ask... Why did you accept my challenge?"
"What do you mean?" Gu Kecheng responded with a puzzled look.
"Did you not see my stats when I sent you the challenge request?"
Yuan could only assume that Gu Kecheng had accepted the challenge without checking them, as that was the most logical explanation.

Gu Kecheng sneered before responding, "I don't know how you managed to bug out the system to make it show such ridiculous stats, but do you think you can scare me with such fake stats? If you're going to do something like that, at least make it more believable!"
"Fake? You think I faked my stats?" Yuan muttered, looking genuinely surprised by Gu Kecheng's response.
"Stop looking down on me! Do you think I am stupid or something?!"
Yuan shook his head and sighed.
"Whatever. You'll find out whether they're real or fake in a moment."
A few moments later, Gu Kecheng made the first move, shooting a barrage of Limitless bullets at Yuan.
'Oh? Looks like he's learned a few things since our last match.' Yuan smiled inwardly when he noticed that Gu Kecheng was no longer using his Limitless recklessly.
Although it appeared threatening at first glance, the bullets carried very little power and were mostly for show, as if Gu Kecheng were trying to intimidate Yuan through sheer numbers alone.
"A neat trick, but it's pointless if you can't aim properly," Yuan remarked as he stood perfectly still, allowing the bullets to miss him without moving an inch.
"Let me show you how it's done."
Yuan created four bullets and fired them at Gu Kecheng, each one striking its mark perfectly. Two hit his shoulders, while the other two struck his knees—one on each side.
"Ah!" Gu Kecheng screamed in pain as he collapsed to his knees, feeling as though someone had smashed both kneecaps with a hammer.
"Here are a few more."

Before Gu Kecheng could even get back to his feet, Yuan showered him with a barrage of bullets. However, each one carried far less power than the previous four, as Yuan had no intention of ending the fight so quickly.
"Get up if you don't want to lose," Yuan said.
With no other choice, Gu Kecheng gritted his teeth and used Limitless to lift himself into the air, as his legs were essentially crippled.
"Fuck you!"

Gu Kecheng cursed as he began bombarding Yuan with Limitless from above. Although his attacks made it seem as though he had lost control, he was actually still regulating his output carefully so that he wouldn't exhaust himself too quickly.
"You've really grown..." Yuan remarked with a smile.
However, his smile quickly faded.
"Unfortunately, you're still a tad bit away from defeating me..."
With a flick of his wrist, Yuan created tens of thousands of bullets from Limitless.
"W-What the hell is that...?" Gu Kecheng muttered in a dazed voice, his eyes wide with bewilderment, as he'd never seen anything even remotely close to what he was currently witnessing before.

"Once we're done here, go tell your family who you bullied today, since you seem to have forgotten. Also, make sure to mention Gu Ming. Tell them that he screamed like a little bitch when I last saw him."
"W-What do you mean by that?!" Gu Kecheng exclaimed.
Yuan offered no response and simply unleashed his attack, bombarding Gu Kecheng with tens of thousands of bullets.
Since each bullet had been deliberately weakened, Gu Kecheng endured several thousand of them before finally being sent back to the waiting room.
Even though the match had already ended, Gu Kecheng could still feel pain, almost as if he was still being struck by the bullets.
"Y-Yuan! I'll definitely make you pay for this!" he cried, tears streaming down his face as snot ran from his nose.

Once Gu Kecheng calmed down a few minutes later, he immediately left the waiting room and waited for Yuan. However, Yuan had left the moment the match ended and went to compete in Last Man Standing to finish his monthly limit for that mode.
After reaching his monthly limit in Last Man Standing with another 100-win streak, Yuan left Gaia's Sanctum entirely and made his way back to base.
Meanwhile, Gu Kecheng called his father after realizing that Yuan was no longer at Gaia's Sanctum.
"Father! Do you know someone by the name of Yuan?! He claimed to have joined the military recently!"
Although he couldn't see it, Gu Kecheng's father immediately frowned upon hearing this familiar name.
"Why are you asking about him?" he asked in a serious tone.

"Unfortunately, you're still a tad bit away from defeating me..."
With a flick of his wrist, Yuan created tens of thousands of bullets from Limitless.
"W-What the hell is that...?" Gu Kecheng muttered in a dazed voice, his eyes wide with bewilderment, as he'd never seen anything even remotely close to what he was currently witnessing before.
"Once we're done here, go tell your family who you bullied today, since you seem to have forgotten.
Also, make sure to mention Gu Ming.
Tell them that he screamed like a little bitch when I last saw him."
"W-What do you mean by that?!" Gu Kecheng exclaimed.
Yuan offered no response and simply unleashed his attack, bombarding Gu Kecheng with tens of thousands of bullets.
Since each bullet had been deliberately weakened, Gu Kecheng endured several thousand of them before finally being sent back to the waiting room.
Even though the match had already ended, Gu Kecheng could still feel pain, almost as if he was still being struck by the bullets.
"Y-Yuan!
I'll definitely make you pay for this!" he cried, tears streaming down his face as snot ran from his nose.
Once Gu Kecheng calmed down a few minutes later, he immediately left the waiting room and waited for Yuan.
However, Yuan had left the moment the match ended and went to compete in Last Man Standing to finish his monthly limit for that mode.
After reaching his monthly limit in Last Man Standing with another 100-win streak, Yuan left Gaia's Sanctum entirely and made his way back to base.
Meanwhile, Gu Kecheng called his father after realizing that Yuan was no longer at Gaia's Sanctum.
"Father!
Do you know someone by the name of Yuan?!
He claimed to have joined the military recently!"
Although he couldn't see it, Gu Kecheng's father immediately frowned upon hearing this familiar name.
"Why are you asking about him?" he asked in a serious tone.

chapters.title: Chapter 2689 Increased Credential Rank
paragraphs: "Answer me, Kecheng! Why are you asking about this man?!"
Gu Kecheng's father shouted when he didn't respond promptly.
"Um... because..."
Gu Kecheng went on to recount his interactions with Yuan to his father, starting with their first encounter over a year ago.

"A year ago, I met this guy and challenged him to a custom match, but I lost... Then, a few days ago, I ran into him again and challenged him to another match. At first, he refused, but he suddenly changed his mind after learning who I was. He said he was acquainted with our family and was even close with Uncle Ming. But after our fight, he said that Uncle Ming screamed like a bitch the last time they spoke... whatever that's supposed to mean."
"Hello? Father?" Gu Kecheng called out when his father did not respond.
"I will call you back later."
Without explaining anything, the father hung up.
Some time later, while in his office, General Gu looked up from his paperwork when someone knocked on his door.
"Who is it?"
"It's me."
Before General Gu even gave permission, the door opened, and a soldier walked inside. It was none other than Captain Gu, the soldier Yuan had fought during his recruitment.
"What is it, Gu Kejian?" General Gu asked with a nonchalant expression.
"It's about Sergeant Yuan. My son, Gu Kecheng, met and interacted with him at Gaia's Sanctum, and he said..."
Gu Kejian recalled everything his son had told him to General Gu.
"That bastard has essentially admitted to being responsible for Gu Ming's disappearance! We should have him arrested immediately!"

General Gu replied with a frown on his face, "Arrest him? And then what? Say that he admitted to killing Gu Ming to your son? Do you realize how ridiculous that sounds? Unless you have it on recording, it's nothing more than hearsay."
"But we have to do something! He killed my brother, Gu Ming!"
"You think I don't want to avenge Gu Ming?!" General Gu suddenly shouted, slamming the desk in a fit of rage.
"Then why—"
"Because I can't do anything right now, especially with the Supreme General paying close attention to him!"
"What? The Supreme General?!" Captain Gu exclaimed, unaware of Yuan's current situation.
"The situation has changed. I can't go into the details right now, but we cannot touch him. However, that doesn't mean he'll be untouchable forever. Just be patient. I am already working on it."
"I understand..."
Meanwhile, after returning to the base, Yuan made his way to Mei Feng's office after being summoned by her.
"You called?"
"I have spoken with the Supreme General.
"What did he say?"
Mei Feng took a deep breath before responding, "The Supreme General has agreed to let you enter Level 2 Black Zone, as well as raise your Credential Rank."
"That's great," Yuan replied.
"You don't sound surprised at all..." Mei Feng remarked. "Were you expecting this?"
"Kind of."
Mei Feng sighed before speaking again, "Although we'll let you go into the Black Zone, you won't be going in alone."
"I don't need protection, though."
"I am aware. They won't be there to protect you, but to observe you..."

After a brief pause, she continued, "I'll be frank. We need to learn everything we can about you, including your secrets. It'd be great if you'd be willing to tell us yourself. If not, we'll do it ourselves."
"What sort of secrets are you referring to?"
"I don't know. Whatever you're hiding."
Mei Feng narrowed her eyes at Yuan.
"I also heard about Major Gu's disappearance..."
"I had nothing to do with that," Yuan said immediately.
"I didn't say you did..."
"Good, because I don't."
An awkward silence filled the room for a good minute before Mei Feng broke it.
"Anyways, you'll also be promoted to Captain... starting now."
She placed his new rank on the table and slid it toward him.
"I've been wondering this for a while now, but how much can I expect my Credential Rank to improve as a Captain?"
"Rank 5."
"So my Credential Rank should increase by two ranks, huh?" Yuan mumbled.
"When can I go to increase my Credential Rank?"
"Give it a few more days before you go."
"Alright."
"When do you want to head to the Black Zone?" Mei Feng then asked.
"Once I increase my Credential Rank, I suppose.
"Well, while we gave you permission, you can't go whenever you want to. You must receive approval first. Sort of like going on leave."
"Is that so? I don't mind, as long as it doesn't take too long to get that approval."
"Don't worry, it won't."
"Is that all?" Yuan asked.
"It is... for now."
Mei Feng dismissed Yuan shortly later.
After leaving, Yuan made his way to the training center, where he'd spend the next several days fighting the Void Hunter on the 48th floor.
A week passed in the blink of an eye, and Yuan made his way to the building that upgraded his Credential Rank—the same place he was arrested not long ago.
Upon arriving, Yuan walked to the front desk.
"How can I help—"
The worker behind the desk suddenly froze mid-sentence when he turned to look at Yuan and recognized him.
It was the same worker who had reported Yuan to the military police after seeing his arrest orders.
"I'm here to upgrade my Credential Rank," Yuan said a moment later, breaking the awkward silence.
"O-Okay..."
After repeating the process from last time, Yuan waited for the results.
"I can confirm that you're eligible for a Credential Rank upgrade. Would you like to do it now?" The worker said, sighing in relief that no arrest orders were active for Yuan.
"Yes."
"Follow me."
The worker stood and led Yuan to another room, where a capsule-shaped machine waited.
"You can enter the machine whenever you're ready."
Yuan nodded and entered the machine.
A few moments later—
<Your Credential Rank has increased a level>
<Your Credential Rank has increased a level>
<Your Credential Rank has increased a level>
<Your Credential Rank has reached Rank 6>

chapters.title: Chapter 2690 Level 5 Treatment
paragraphs: "Oh? Credential Rank 6?" Yuan muttered in a pleasantly surprised voice after seeing that his Credential Rank had gone up a level more than he had anticipated, wondering if the Supreme General had something to do with it.
The worker opened the machine shortly later and said, "It's done. Your Credential Rank has been upgraded."
"Thank you."
"Umm... sorry for what happened during your prior visit."
Yuan shook his head.
"There's no need to apologize, as you were simply doing your job."

After leaving the building, Yuan headed home to remove his curses. Although he could have done so there, he felt it would be more appropriate to handle something like that in private, even if the entire process was carried out through the system.
Once he was inside his room, Yuan sat in the lotus position and closed his eyes.
"System, remove my curses."
<Checking the user's condition>
<Gaia's System has sensed an anomaly in the user>
<Searching for Treatment>
<Treatment Found>
<Utilizing Level 4 Treatment>
<Treatment Completed>
<A curse has been removed from the user>
The moment the curse was removed, Yuan immediately felt lighter, as though invisible chains he had never realized were binding him had been stripped away.
But he wasn't done, and the next treatment immediately began.
<Gaia's System has sensed an anomaly in the user>
<Searching for Treatment>
<Treatment Found>
<Utilizing Level 5 Treatment>
However, upon reaching this point, something unexpected happened.
<Warning! Warning! Warning!>
Warnings started appearing before Yuan.
[Warning: Level 5 treatment may cause intense pain for the user due to the nature of the anomaly]
Yuan swallowed nervously when he saw this.
"I guess I was naive to think this would go smoothly..." he sighed, though he wasn't particularly surprised by it.
"Proceed with treatment."
After mentally preparing himself, Yuan approved of the treatment.
<Treatment has been approved by the user>
<Utilizing Level 5 Treatment>
The pain came swiftly and fiercely, tearing through Yuan's entire body as though every part of him were being ripped apart over and over again.

He could feel his muscles being torn apart, his bones shattering into countless pieces, and even every cell in his body bursting—all at once. The agony rivaled the pain he had experienced when his soul was being destroyed by the Celestial Emperor, if not surpassed it entirely.

Yuan tried his best to suppress the urge to scream, but his resistance did not last long. Shortly after the treatment began, agonized screams erupted from his throat with enough force to make the entire building tremble.
Had it not been for the sound-concealment formations within the building, his screams would have pierced through the walls and echoed outside.
<Treatment Completed>
<A curse has been removed from the user>

Although the entire treatment lasted no more than ten minutes, it felt like an eternity to Yuan, and by the end, he was soaked in sweat, looking like he'd just emerged from being fully submerged in water.
Afterward, Yuan lay on the floor, staring blankly at the ceiling as he quietly wondered what had changed.
'It doesn't feel like anything has changed, but there's no way a treatment that caused such an intense reaction did nothing!' he thought.
'Now that I think about it... What even are these curses?'
He recalled his meeting with Zhai Ye, an expert on curses.
'He claimed that I have multiple natural curses on me...

Although Yuan had known for some time that he was afflicted by several powerful curses, he still had no idea how they affected him or how he had acquired them in the first place. Despite being told that they were natural curses, his instincts told him otherwise.
"How ridiculous..." Yuan sighed out loud.
However, knowing nothing about the curses wasn't even the worst part.
"That was just a level 5 treatment..."

When Yuan first acquired Gaia's System, it had attempted to administer a Level 9 treatment but failed due to his insufficient credentials. This meant he still had at least four more treatments ahead of him, each potentially more painful than the last.
Even though Yuan was accustomed to pain and had tempered his mental fortitude to unfathomable levels, he still felt a trace of nervousness when thinking about his future treatments.
"Let's not immediately begin the next treatment..."

In the end, Yuan decided to postpone the Level 6 treatment. Not only would doing so give him some time to mentally prepare himself, but it would also allow him to observe and compare the changes brought about by each treatment... if there were even any.
Some time later, after he had rested enough, Yuan cleaned his room before washing himself as well.

After stepping out of the bathroom, he considered going to Mei Feng to inform her that he wanted to enter the Black Zone and continue his training. However, just as he reached the door to go outside, a profound change suddenly occurred within his body, forcing him to his knees.
Yuan stared at the floor, looking bewildered.
'My body... feels incredibly weak!' he cried inwardly, feeling as though something had sapped away all of his strength in an instant.
He quickly examined his body, but he couldn't find anything wrong with it, and even his Dantian and cultivation appeared perfectly fine.
'What's going on? Why do I feel so weak when nothing about my body has changed?'
Suddenly, a realization struck him.
"What if it wasn't my body that changed... but my soul?" he muttered in a daze.
He immediately examined his soul, and sure enough, it felt different from before. But no matter how carefully he inspected it, he couldn't determine exactly what had changed.
With no other choice, Yuan lay on the floor and continued examining his soul while waiting to see if his condition would improve with time.
Yet, as time passed, his condition only worsened, eventually reaching the point where he could no longer remain conscious and slowly drifted into a deep slumber.

As he slept, Yuan dreamed of Gaia's Heaven—of the time when he had first arrived in this world. However, there were major differences between the dream and what he actually experienced, making it feel almost like an entirely different life.

chapters.title: Chapter 2691 Hospitalized
paragraphs: "Have any of you seen Yuan lately?" Wu Wang asked his squad members after their mission briefing ended.
"No, I haven't." Shi Fa shook his head.
The others also shook their head.
"I heard that he'd come back from the assembly three months ago, but I haven't seen or heard from him since, said Sergeant Bing.
"How odd..." Wu Wang muttered.
"Why is that so odd?" Shi Fa asked.
"I don't know. It just feels weird when his presence is lacking, especially when he was always in the spotlight during his first year."
Suddenly, Sergeant Quang received a message, and when he read it, he muttered aloud, "Speaking of the devil... the General wants me to call him to her office."
"I'll come with you, since we'll be heading out afterward, anyway," said Wu Wang.
"Me too," said Sergeant Bing.
"I might as well..." Shi Fa said.
Shortly later, the four of them made their way to Yuan's living quarters.
*Knock* *Knock*
Wu Wang knocked on the door.
"Is he not home?" he muttered when nobody answered the door.
He knocked again a moment later.
"What now?" Wu Wang turned to ask the others.
"Maybe he left on a mission?" Shi Fa remarked.
"I highly doubt the General would ask me to call him if she knew he went out on a mission," Sergeant Quang said.
"He's probably sleeping in his room or something. Let's go wake him up," Wu Wang said as he subconsciously reached for the doorknob without thinking about how he'd open the locked door.
However, the doorknob turned without issue, and he opened the door.
"The door... wasn't locked?" Shi Fa frowned when he saw this.
Wu Wang cautiously pushed the door open, but it only moved halfway before something behind it stopped it from opening further.
"Huh?"
That was when they noticed the lower half of someone's body lying on the floor behind the door.
"Y-Yuan?!
Wu Wang swiftly entered the building, sliding through the gap.
"H-Hey! Someone call medical! He's knocked out!" Wu Wang shouted from the inside.
Hearing this, Sergeant Quang picked up his phone and immediately called General Mei.
"What?" Mei Feng frowned upon hearing the news that Yuan was found unconscious in his own home, wondering if General Gu had done something again.
"There's no way he's that stupid... is he?" she muttered, summoning medical staff to his living quarters, as well as going there herself.
By the time Mei Feng arrived at Yuan's living quarters, the medical staff had just put him on a stretcher and were prepared to take him away.
Mei Feng's eyes widened with shock when she saw Yuan being taken away, as there were some unexpected changes to his appearance.
"What's his condition?" she asked one of the medical personnel who had stayed behind.

"It's a little puzzling," the medic replied. "His vitals are stable, and there doesn't appear to be anything wrong with his body. At a glance, he seems perfectly healthy, yet for some reason, he remains unconscious. Until we conduct a more thorough examination, we won't be able to determine what's wrong."
"Keep me updated."
"Yes, General."
Once the medics left, Mei Feng turned her attention to Wu Wang and the others.
"What happened?"
Shi Fa explained everything from the moment they arrived at Yuan's living quarters.
"What did the medics say?" Wu Wang later asked. "They wouldn't disclose anything to us."
"They won't know without a thorough examination, but they said his vitals and body were fine."
"Fine? Even though he... looked like that?" Wu Wang swallowed nervously.
Some time later, Mei Feng went to the hospital that Yuan was taken to and waited for the results.
A few hours and multiple examinations later—
"There's nothing wrong with him?!" Mei Feng's eyes widened at the news, her expression full of disbelief.
"A healthy individual doesn't collapse and change so drastically!" she said.
"I don't know what else to tell you, General. We couldn't find anything wrong with his body."
"So what now?" Mei Feng asked after a moment of silence.
"We can only wait for him to wake up.
Mei Feng sighed, but there was nothing she could do.
After leaving the hospital, Mei Feng notified Supreme General Tian of the situation.
"Do you think foul play is possible?" Mei Feng asked.
"No."
Supreme General Tian answered swiftly and decisively, catching Mei Feng by surprise.

"I've had soldiers keeping an eye on him ever since we returned from the assembly. They reported that he went straight home after having his credentials upgraded, and no one has approached him since then."
"Perhaps it's a side effect of his Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique," Supreme General Tian then said.
"Hopefully it turns out to be nothing..." Mei Feng sighed. "If he dies, I cannot imagine how the other cities would react, even if it wasn't our fault."
As time passed, news of Yuan's hospitalization spread throughout the military, giving rise to all sorts of new rumors and conspiracy theories.
"I bet it's another assassination attempt on him..."
"How unlucky and unpopular is that guy to be targeted constantly?"
One month... two months...
Time passed swiftly, and in the blink of an eye, the military's next recruitment period had already arrived.
"Did you hear? General Gu had apparently recruited some incredible talent!"
"How incredible are we talking? Unless they can beat Captain Yuan's record, it's nothing worth mentioning."
"Although they didn't break any records yet, the recruitment hasn't ended. Let's go check it out."
People started going to watch the recruitment just to get a glimpse of this new talent.
"Wow! What a beauty!"
"Li Jieyu, huh? Isn't that surname popular in a certain city?"
"I know of one background with that surname, and they're a powerhouse in Ember City. But why would they send someone from a place like that to join our military?"
"It must be a coincidence."
"Check out that other beauty. Although she's not quite as impressive as Li Jieyu, her performance would still be considered elite."
"Hey! I actually know that woman! But why is she here?!"
"Who is she?"
"She's Huang Zi Han, the young lady of the Huang Family in Jade City! Her family is one of the wealthiest in the entire world!"

Eventually, people realized that many of the participants in this year's recruitment had come from other cities. In fact, the number of applicants was among the highest in history, with a large majority coming from outside Gaia's Heaven!
