"No, I haven't." Shi Fa shook his head.
The others also shook their head.
"I heard that he'd come back from the assembly three months ago, but I haven't seen or heard from him since, said Sergeant Bing.
"How odd..." Wu Wang muttered.
"Why is that so odd?" Shi Fa asked.
"I don't know.
It just feels weird when his presence is lacking, especially when he was always in the spotlight during his first year."
Suddenly, Sergeant Quang received a message, and when he read it, he muttered aloud, "Speaking of the devil... the General wants me to call him to her office."
"I'll come with you, since we'll be heading out afterward, anyway," said Wu Wang.
"Me too," said Sergeant Bing.
"I might as well..." Shi Fa said.
Shortly later, the four of them made their way to Yuan's living quarters.
*Knock* *Knock*
Wu Wang knocked on the door.
"Is he not home?" he muttered when nobody answered the door.
He knocked again a moment later.
"What now?" Wu Wang turned to ask the others.
"Maybe he left on a mission?" Shi Fa remarked.
"I highly doubt the General would ask me to call him if she knew he went out on a mission," Sergeant Quang said.
"He's probably sleeping in his room or something.
Let's go wake him up," Wu Wang said as he subconsciously reached for the doorknob without thinking about how he'd open the locked door.
However, the doorknob turned without issue, and he opened the door.
"The door... wasn't locked?" Shi Fa frowned when he saw this.
Wu Wang cautiously pushed the door open, but it only moved halfway before something behind it stopped it from opening further.
"Huh?"
That was when they noticed the lower half of someone's body lying on the floor behind the door.
"Y-Yuan?!
Wu Wang swiftly entered the building, sliding through the gap.
"H-Hey!
Someone call medical!
He's knocked out!" Wu Wang shouted from the inside.
Hearing this, Sergeant Quang picked up his phone and immediately called General Mei.
"What?" Mei Feng frowned upon hearing the news that Yuan was found unconscious in his own home, wondering if General Gu had done something again.
"There's no way he's that stupid... is he?" she muttered, summoning medical staff to his living quarters, as well as going there herself.
By the time Mei Feng arrived at Yuan's living quarters, the medical staff had just put him on a stretcher and were prepared to take him away.
Mei Feng's eyes widened with shock when she saw Yuan being taken away, as there were some unexpected changes to his appearance.
"What's his condition?" she asked one of the medical personnel who had stayed behind.
"It's a little puzzling," the medic replied.
"His vitals are stable, and there doesn't appear to be anything wrong with his body.
At a glance, he seems perfectly healthy, yet for some reason, he remains unconscious.
Until we conduct a more thorough examination, we won't be able to determine what's wrong."
"Keep me updated."
"Yes, General."
Once the medics left, Mei Feng turned her attention to Wu Wang and the others.
"What happened?"
Shi Fa explained everything from the moment they arrived at Yuan's living quarters.
"What did the medics say?" Wu Wang later asked.
"They wouldn't disclose anything to us."
"They won't know without a thorough examination, but they said his vitals and body were fine."
"Fine?
Even though he... looked like that?" Wu Wang swallowed nervously.
Some time later, Mei Feng went to the hospital that Yuan was taken to and waited for the results.
A few hours and multiple examinations later—
"There's nothing wrong with him?!" Mei Feng's eyes widened at the news, her expression full of disbelief.
"A healthy individual doesn't collapse and change so drastically!" she said.
"I don't know what else to tell you, General.
We couldn't find anything wrong with his body."
"So what now?" Mei Feng asked after a moment of silence.
"We can only wait for him to wake up.
Mei Feng sighed, but there was nothing she could do.
After leaving the hospital, Mei Feng notified Supreme General Tian of the situation.
"Do you think foul play is possible?" Mei Feng asked.
"No."
Supreme General Tian answered swiftly and decisively, catching Mei Feng by surprise.
"I've had soldiers keeping an eye on him ever since we returned from the assembly.
They reported that he went straight home after having his credentials upgraded, and no one has approached him since then."
"Perhaps it's a side effect of his Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique," Supreme General Tian then said.
"Hopefully it turns out to be nothing..." Mei Feng sighed.
"If he dies, I cannot imagine how the other cities would react, even if it wasn't our fault."
As time passed, news of Yuan's hospitalization spread throughout the military, giving rise to all sorts of new rumors and conspiracy theories.
"I bet it's another assassination attempt on him..."
"How unlucky and unpopular is that guy to be targeted constantly?"
One month... two months...
Time passed swiftly, and in the blink of an eye, the military's next recruitment period had already arrived.
"Did you hear?
General Gu had apparently recruited some incredible talent!"
"How incredible are we talking?
Unless they can beat Captain Yuan's record, it's nothing worth mentioning."
"Although they didn't break any records yet, the recruitment hasn't ended.
Let's go check it out."
People started going to watch the recruitment just to get a glimpse of this new talent.
"Wow!
What a beauty!"
"Li Jieyu, huh?
Isn't that surname popular in a certain city?"
"I know of one background with that surname, and they're a powerhouse in Ember City.
But why would they send someone from a place like that to join our military?"
"It must be a coincidence."
"Check out that other beauty.
Although she's not quite as impressive as Li Jieyu, her performance would still be considered elite."
"Hey!
I actually know that woman!
But why is she here?!"
"Who is she?"
"She's Huang Zi Han, the young lady of the Huang Family in Jade City!
Her family is one of the wealthiest in the entire world!"
Eventually, people realized that many of the participants in this year's recruitment had come from other cities.
In fact, the number of applicants was among the highest in history, with a large majority coming from outside Gaia's Heaven!

chapters.title: Chapter 2692 Hospitalized(2)
paragraphs: "What's going on? Why are so many foreigners trying to join our military this year? Are we being invaded?"
"Although foreigners are allowed to join the military, they are usually extremely rare. This number is too abnormal! Something is definitely happening!"
Meanwhile, in the spectators' room reserved for the higher-ups, the officers were just as puzzled as the ordinary soldiers, as they had yet to be briefed on the situation.
"What the hell is going on?"
"General Mei, do you know anything?"
They turned to her for answers.
After a moment of silence, she responded, "I can't tell you anything right now, but there will likely be a briefing about this later."
And so, they all returned to watching the recruitment and continued wondering inwardly about the situation.
Although Supreme General Tian couldn't be bothered to watch the recruitment, he had been alerted to the situation.

"So that's how they want to play, huh?" A bitter smile tugged at Supreme General Tian's lips. "Although it's a little shameless, at least this means they've decided against going to war. However, this also means we won't be able to keep things hidden for any longer."
He turned to look at the black-haired woman and asked, "What do you think?"
"What is that man's condition right now?" she asked.
"As far as I am aware, he's still unconscious."
After a moment of silence, she spoke, "There's no point in hiding it now."
"Then I will address the situation after the recruitment," said Supreme General Tian.
Time passed, and in the blink of an eye, the recruitment came to an end.
"Although Li Jieyu was unable to break any records, she came very close to many of them. She definitely has the potential to rival Captain Yuan!"
"Isn't he still hospitalized right now? It'd be a pity if he were to die...
"Is he even still alive? He could've died long ago."
"I guess we'll find out soon, as a mass summoning had just been issued."
Shortly after the recruitment ended, every soldier was summoned to the Parade Deck.
The soldiers expected either General Mei or General Gu to speak, but to their shock, the Supreme General had appeared.
"That's the Supreme General?!"
"Don't tell me this is his retirement speech?"
Many expected to hear about the Supreme General's retirement, but their expectations were shattered once again when he revealed the true situation to them.
Supreme General Tian first spoke about what had occurred during the assembly before moving on to the main subject.

"Because of his Perfected Heavenly Refinement Physique, Captain Yuan is currently the only person in this world capable of fighting the Void Hunter—and potentially defeating it. The reason so many people from other cities have participated in this year's recruitment is directly related to that."
The soldiers were left bewildered and speechless by this revelation, but they also believed that they'd found the explanation behind Yuan's unfathomable talents.
"Lastly... I'm sure you've all heard the rumors, but Captain Yuan is currently hospitalized. Although I won't disclose the reason, I can assure you that his condition is stable."
The briefing lasted only a few minutes, yet by the time it ended, it had left every soldier with lingering unease and uncertainty.
Although the mass briefing had ended, another was held shortly afterward for the higher-ups, this time delving into the finer details of the situation.
However, Yuan's true condition was still kept secret. In fact, aside from Mei Feng and those assigned to monitor him, no one else knew the truth—not even General Gu.
"I still don't understand why the other cities are sending people into our military. How does that benefit them?" one of the officers asked.
"They're most likely trying to establish a connection with Captain Yuan—or, at the very least, secure a direct line of communication with him.
"That sounds like espionage."
"Are we going to do anything about it? Or are we simply going to let these foreigners flood our military despite knowing they have ulterior motives?" another officer asked.
"They may be foreigners, but before they're allowed to join, they must sever their ties to their former affiliations and swear their loyalty to Gaia's Heaven."

"We know that, but that doesn't mean they won't secretly pass classified information back to their former cities. I believe we should prohibit them from joining our military altogether. It's the only way to protect our integrity."
Many officers shared the same sentiment.
Supreme General Tian sighed and said, "It's either this, or we go to war."
"That's..."
The officers fell silent at the word 'war'.
"Whether you like it or not, the world is changing fast, and we can only adapt to it."
"So what are we going to do if something happens to Captain Yuan? This is all happening because of him, right?"
After a brief moment of silence, Supreme General Tian responded, "I can't see the future. I will deal with it when the time comes."
General Gu suddenly raised his hand and spoke, "What about your retirement, Supreme General?"
Supreme General Tian sneered.

"You think I don't want to retire already? Unfortunately, with everything that's happened, I have no choice but to remain in my position a little longer... at least until we can see a clear path forward and find a solution."

One might have expected General Gu to be upset by the delay in Supreme General Tian's retirement, but in reality, he was pleased. It gave him more time to expand his influence, especially now that so many outsiders were joining Gaia's Heaven and presenting him with connections and opportunities he had never had access to before—at least, not this easily.
'I was already behind General Mei, so this is the perfect opportunity for me to catch up and surpass her, especially now that I have a decent talent on my side!' he thought to himself.
Meanwhile, at the hospital, a black-haired woman quietly entered the room where Yuan was staying.
Normally, his room would have been monitored around the clock, yet for some reason, no one was present at that moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 2693 Chief of Operations
paragraphs: "So, you're the troublemaker who claims to have come from another world, huh?"
The black-haired woman muttered as she stared at Yuan's sleeping face.

"I thought you were insignificant... nothing more than a passing breeze, especially since 'it' never mentioned anything about you. But that is clearly no longer the case..." she mumbled, her voice tinged with puzzlement.
"Who are you? And what is your purpose for coming to this world?" she questioned aloud, even though she knew Yuan wouldn't be able to answer them.
While the woman was lost in thought, Yuan's body suddenly twitched.
Although the woman could've left at that moment, for some reason, she decided to stay behind.
'Is he having a nightmare?' she wondered to herself as she watched Yuan's expression twist in pain.
Yuan's body continued twitching for several more moments before suddenly going completely still.
The change was so abrupt that, for a split second, the woman thought he had died. Of course, that was not the case.
A moment later, the woman noticed movement in Yuan's face once again. This time, it was his eyes, and they were slowly beginning to open.
Once again, the woman had the opportunity to leave. Yet, for some reason, her foot remained rooted to the ground, almost as if a mysterious force was making her stay.
Eventually, Yuan's eyes fully opened.
After waking, he stared silently at the white ceiling for several moments before slowly turning his head to look around. His gaze soon settled on the black-haired woman standing several steps away.
His eyes widened slightly, almost as if he couldn't believe what he was seeing.
"Yu... Yu Rou?" he muttered in a daze.
The black-haired woman standing before him looked exactly like his sister, Yu Rou.
The woman's expression immediately changed, and she stared at him warily.
"How... How do you know my name?" she asked after a moment of silence.
"I... just do?" Yuan replied.

The woman—Yu Rou fell silent. This was definitely their first time meeting, and any information on her identity was strictly prohibited. In fact, only the Supreme General knew her true name in the entire military, so any chance of it being exposed was nonexistent.
Then she recalled that Yuan claimed to be from another world.
"Do I also exist in your world? The one you claimed to have come from," she asked, ignoring how ridiculous it sounded.
And to her surprise, Yuan nodded his head.
"What's your relationship with her?" she asked.
"Does it really matter?" Yuan replied.
"No... I suppose it doesn't," Yu Rou muttered after a brief moment of thought.
After all, Yuan's relationship in another world was none of her business, even if that other individual was her, as they were not actually the same person.
After a moment of silence, she asked, "Do you know why you became unconscious?"
"I do... but I also don't. It's hard to explain.
"Should we be worried about it? You're the world's only hope of defeating the Void Hunter, after all."
"If you're asking whether or not I will suddenly die, then you don't have to worry."
"I see."
"Who are you, anyway?" Yuan suddenly asked.
Yu Rou opened her mouth to answer, but hesitation flickered in her eyes, causing her to stop herself. A moment later, however, she spoke.
"I am the Chief of Operations."
"And what is your role in the military?"
"Let's just say that whenever the Supreme General needs a second opinion, he comes to me."
"So, you're a pretty big shot, huh? Then can I ask why you're here? Do you have some business with me?"
"Mostly to satisfy my curiosity," she replied, giving Yuan an answer he hadn't expected.
"I needed to meet you eventually, so I figured I might do it while everyone's attention is elsewhere. I'm not really supposed to be out and about like this, after all."
"So you snuck out to meet me, huh?" Yuan smiled.
"Anything else?"
Yu Rou remained silent for a brief moment before asking, "I heard that you want to meet Gaia. Why?"
"I have a feeling that I was brought to this world to meet them," he calmly replied. "Moreover, Gaia also wants me to find them."
Yu Rou raised an eyebrow at such words and asked in a puzzled tone, "Gaia wants you to find them? How do you know this?"
"Because they told me."
"That's not possible." Yu Rou responded confidently.
"You're lying."
"Why would I lie?" Yuan shook his head.
"Then how did they tell you?"
"Through Gaia's System."
"That's..."
Yu Rou's expression shifted once again, but this time the change was far more profound, rendering her thoughts completely unreadable.
"What are you going to do once you meet them?" Yu Rou asked a moment later.
Yuan shrugged.
"Who knows? I'll figure it out once I meet them."
Yu Rou narrowed her eyes and said, "If you want to meet Gaia, you'll need my approval."
"Oh? And how do I acquire your approval?
"Defeat the Void Hunter."
Yuan fell silent.
"And before you get the wrong idea, I'm not trying to use you. In fact, I couldn't care less whether the Void Hunter is defeated or not," she suddenly said.
"Why is that?" Yuan asked with a raised eyebrow.
"Because anything not mentioned in Gaia's Prophecy holds no real significance. The Void Hunter was never mentioned, so its existence is ultimately irrelevant in the grand scheme of things."
"So, in your eyes, the Celestial Beings are a greater threat than the Void Hunter? In that case, why don't you ask me to deal with them instead?"
"If you can't even handle the Void Hunter, what chance could you possibly have against the Celestial Beings?" Yu Rou sneered disdainfully.
As harsh as her words sounded, Yuan wasn't offended by them. As a matter of fact, he agreed with her that the Celestial Beings—the Eternals were even more dangerous than the Void Hunter.
Yuan suddenly removed the monitors attached to his arms and chest, then got out of bed.
"Just to confirm, if I defeat the Void Hunter, you'll let me meet Gaia?"
Yu Rou nodded.
"I was already planning on defeating it, but you just gave me a little more motivation," Yuan said with a smile.
"I'll defeat it. Give me a few years."
"Take all the time you need."
"I wish I could."
"...Well, good luck."
Without saying anything else, Yu Rou left the room.
Meanwhile, Yuan walked over to a mirror inside the room. The moment he saw his reflection, his eyes widened at the change in his appearance.
'What the hell? Did I accidentally transform?' Yuan wondered inwardly.

His once-black hair had turned pure white, while his originally brown eyes now shimmered with a myriad of colors, as though each contained an entire universe within. The sight gave him an unnatural—almost otherworldly—appearance.

It wasn't just his hair and eyes, either. His mature features had somehow become noticeably younger, as though his age itself had regressed. He had gone from looking like a fully grown adult to a young man again, almost as if he had returned to the days when he had only recently begun his journey as a cultivator.
"Did removing the curse cause this change? This is crazy..." Yuan sighed.
With such an otherworldly appearance, Yuan could hardly blame anyone for mistaking him for a Void Specter now.
"And I still have several more treatments to go..."

He wanted to change his appearance back to its original, more human state, but unfortunately, appearance-altering pills did not exist in this world. Even if they did, he had no way of obtaining one at the moment.
With no other choice, Yuan left the room in his current appearance... hospital gown and all.

He wanted to change his appearance back to its original, more human state, but unfortunately, appearance-altering pills did not exist in this world.
Even if they did, he had no way of obtaining one at the moment.
With no other choice, Yuan left the room in his current appearance... hospital gown and all.

chapters.title: Chapter 2694 Yuan's Awakening
paragraphs: "H-Hey! Stop!"
A startled cry rang out just as Yuan reached the exit.
When he turned around, he saw a frantic-looking nurse hurrying toward him.
"You can't just leave without a word after waking up!" she exclaimed once she caught up.
Before Yuan could respond, the nurse asked, "Are you okay? Do you feel pain anywhere? Do you remember what happened before your collapse?"
"I'm fine. I don't feel pain anywhere. And yes, I remember that I was leaving the house when I collapsed."
"Come with me. We need to examine your body again just in case."
"There's no need. I am perfectly healthy."

The nurse frowned. "With that appearance? I don't think so. General Mei also ordered us not to let you leave this hospital without her approval, so we'll contact her and let her know you've woken up. Until then, you'll have to stay here."
"Fine..."
So Yuan followed the nurse back to his room, where they thoroughly examined his body for any changes.
To nobody's surprise, they didn't discover anything new, and his condition appeared the same as the day he was discovered unconscious.
Meanwhile, Mei Feng was notified of Yuan's awakening.
When she heard the news, she dropped what she was doing and headed to the hospital.
Some time later, Mei Feng met Yuan in his room.
"How are you feeling?" she asked.
"Perfectly fine."
"Have you looked in the mirror yet?"
"I have."
"And you still dare to say you're perfectly fine? If the others saw you like this, they'd definitely question whether you were even human."
"I don't know why my appearance changed like this, but I really am fine."
Mei Feng narrowed her eyes at him.
"Are you sure you have no idea? This happened right after you upgraded your Credential Rank, and considering that two of your anomalies have disappeared, I think we both know what caused it.
Yuan sighed.
"Yes, I treated two of my anomalies, and this was the result. However, I still don't know exactly why it happened or why removing those anomalies caused such a drastic change."

Mei Feng fell silent for a moment before speaking. "I had some of the best doctors in our city examine your anomalies, but even they were completely stumped. According to them, your condition defied all logic."
"So, what now?" Yuan then asked.
"First, we need to change your appearance—revert it back to how it was."
"I don't think I can control it."
"I wasn't expecting you to," Mei Feng said as she retrieved a small, square-shaped chip about the size of her thumb.
"If you attach this to your body, it'll create an illusion around you and alter your appearance in the eyes of everyone nearby."
"It's extremely expensive and typically used only for covert missions, but this is a special occasion. Try not to damage it."
Yuan accepted the chip and asked, "Where should I put it?"
"Anywhere on your body is fine. Preferably somewhere hidden from plain sight and unlikely to be struck."
Yuan thought for a moment before attaching the chip to his lower back, just above his tailbone.
The chip activated immediately. Although Yuan felt no different, in Mei Feng's eyes, his appearance had already returned to normal.
"Remember, it's quite fragile, and it can even be damaged by water. A little sweat won't hurt, but don't submerge it in water, so take it off when you bathe."
"Anything else?"
"Do you have anything you need from me?" Mei Feng asked.
"Actually, I do. I was planning to find you before I collapsed. I'm ready to head to the Level 2 Black Zone, so I would appreciate it if you could get it approved as soon as possible."
Mei Feng stared at him with a baffled expression.
"You know you just woke up from a several-month-long coma, right? The Supreme General would never allow you to leave until he's certain that you're in a stable condition."
"Well, how do I convince him that I am fine?"
"You'll have to ask him yourself. He'll likely want to speak with you later."
Yuan sighed.
"Fine, then I'll—
Yuan suddenly paused.
"Wait. I've been unconscious for how long?"
"Almost half a year. Five months and eleven days, to be exact."
"I've been asleep for half a year?!" Yuan exclaimed.
"Even the dream wasn't that long!"
"Dream?" Mei Feng raised an eyebrow before inquiring, "What kind of dream?"
"I was dreaming while I was unconscious. Uh... what was it about again?"
Despite his usually perfect memory, Yuan couldn't recall the dream no matter how hard he tried, almost as if some unknown force was preventing him from accessing it.
However, although he couldn't remember the dream itself, the emotions it had left behind remained vivid—pain, sadness, anger, regret. Most of them were overwhelmingly negative.
"Forget it," Mei Feng interrupted Yuan's thoughts, dismissing its importance.
"Anyway, stay here for a little longer and wait for the Supreme General to summon you."
"What other choice do I have?" Yuan shook his head.
Before leaving, Mei Feng told him about the military's current situation and the recruitment that had just ended.
"Oh? New recruits? Do you have a recording? It'll help me pass the time."
Mei Feng nodded. "I'll have it sent to you as soon as I return to my office."
Mei Feng left, and three hours later, someone delivered the recording to Yuan.
"How are you feeling?" Mei Xiaoyun, who was chosen to deliver the recording, asked him.
"I'm fine."
"Really? My mother refused to tell me anything about your condition."
"Because she didn't want you to worry needlessly. Anyway, I am about to watch a recording of the recent recruitment. Want to join me?" Yuan said, quickly changing the subject.
"That's what my mother had me deliver? A recording of the recruitment?" Mei Xiaoyun sighed after learning what it was.

She then added, "I'll watch it with you. I didn't get to see it live, and I heard there were quite a few promising talents this year. Apparently, one of them even came close to breaking your records."

chapters.title: Chapter 2695 Discharged
paragraphs: Shortly after they began watching the recording of the recent recruitment, Yuan's eyes widened when Li Jieyu appeared on the screen, as she looked exactly like Li Jinxi.
But the surprises didn't end there, as Huang Zhi Han soon appeared as well.
"Those two must be the top talents in the recruitment. I heard that they're both from another city," Mei Xiaoyun said. "In fact, many participants this year are foreigners."
"I didn't know people from another city were allowed to join our military," Yuan remarked.

"It's possible, but they're required to give up their original citizenship and sever their ties with their former city. I heard it's extremely rare for anyone to do that, but... this year was different."
As she said this, Mei Xiaoyun slowly turned her head to look at Yuan.
Although she already knew about his Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique and understood that it was extraordinary, she could never have imagined just how significant it truly was.
"To think you are able to fight the Void Hunter already when you were only at the First Ascension a year ago. Aren't you growing a little too fast?" she sighed.

"I am nowhere near strong enough to fight the Void Hunter," Yuan said while shaking his head. "When I fought it before, it was merely messing around with me. Had it truly wanted to kill me, I wouldn't be here right now."
"Even if that's the case, given how fast you're improving, I don't doubt you'll be strong enough to defeat it soon."
"You sure have a lot of confidence in me."
Mei Xiaoyun did not respond and fell silent.
Some time later, they finished watching the recording.
"What do you think?" Mei Xiaoyun asked him.
A smile tugged at Yuan's lips as he responded, "I think I can finally officially create my squad."
Mei Xiaoyun raised an eyebrow.
"Who are you going to invite into our squad?"
"Isn't it obvious? Li Jieyu and Huang Zhi Han. With these two, we'd have exactly four members."
"You think you'll be the only one to invite them? I bet they've already received hundreds of squad invitations by now."
"That may be the case, but whether they accept them or not is another matter."
Yuan turned to face Mei Xiaoyun and continued, "Since I am stuck in this place for now, I'll need you to do the recruiting for me."
"You can't be serious..."
"Do you want our squad to become official or not?"
"Quite frankly... I don't really care," she said.
"Seriously?"
She nodded with a serious expression.
Before Yuan could say anything else, Mei Xiaoyun spoke, "But I'll send them an invitation, at the very least. Don't expect me to beg them or anything like that."
"Of course not. Just mention my name."
Mei Xiaoyun left shortly afterward to search for Li Jieyu and Huang Zhi Han.
It didn't take her long to locate Huang Zhi Han, thanks to her already immense reputation and eye-catching appearance.
Once Huang Zhi Han was alone, Mei Xiaoyun approached her.
"Hello, are you Huang Zhi Han?"
"I am. How can I help you?"
"I'm here on behalf of my squad leader to invite you to join our squad," she replied.

Huang Zhi Han swiftly refused. "Sorry, but I'm not interested—especially if your squad leader couldn't even be bothered to come and invite me personally. I've already received over three hundred invitations, and every single one came directly from the squad leaders themselves. Many of them even brought gifts."
"My squad leader, Captain Yuan, is in a peculiar situation, so he can't come. Anyways, since you refused, I won't bother you any long—"
"Wait."
Just as Mei Xiaoyun turned around, a hand grabbed her shoulder, stopping her.
"Your squad leader is Yuan? As in 'that' Yuan?" Huang Zhi Han asked for clarification.
"There's only one man named Yuan in the military, so... probably?" Mei Xiaoyun responded.
"I'll join your squad. What is it called?"
Mei Xiaoyun was a little surprised at how quickly Huang Zhi Han's attitude changed after hearing Yuan's name.
'I guess the rumors that most of the foreigners came here for him are true...' she sighed inwardly.
"Nine Heavens. He'll approve it whenever he can. See you."
"I am not finished." Huang Zhi Han stopped her from leaving again.
"I heard that Yuan was hospitalized several months ago and nobody has seen or heard from him since then, so how did you...?" Huang Zhi Han asked with a doubtful gaze.
Mei Xiaoyun remained silent for a moment before responding, "Since you'll be part of the squad, I guess it'll be fine to tell you. I met with him just before coming here."
"Is he okay? What caused him to be hospitalized? I can hardly imagine how someone who survived the Void Hunter could be hospitalized."
"I don't know." Mei Xiaoyun shook her head. "If you really want to know, you can ask him yourself. He should be discharged soon, after all."
"Any other questions before I leave?"
"What... What is your relationship with Yuan?" Huang Zhi Han asked after a brief pause.
"We're just acquaintances."
Huang Zhi Han didn't believe Mei Xiaoyun for a second, but she chose not to press the matter any further. After all, she would find out the truth herself sooner or later.
"One last thing. I haven't heard your name yet."
"Mei Xiaoyun."
"Your surname is Mei? Are you, by any chance, related to General Mei?"
"She's my mother."
"I see... that explains a lot," Huang Zhi Han mumbled.
"Sorry for taking up your time, and see you around."

One might have expected Huang Zhi Han to attend boot camp after recruitment, but because of her outstanding results and her existing mastery of Void Control, she was granted special permission to skip it entirely. Naturally, Li Jieyu received the same treatment.

After successfully recruiting Huang Zhi Han, Mei Xiaoyun immediately began searching for Li Jieyu. However, unlike Huang Zhi Han, Li Jieyu was like a ghost. No one seemed to know where she was or how to find her, leaving Mei Xiaoyun with no choice but to give up for the time being.
Time passed swiftly, and five days after Yuan's awakening, Supreme General Tian showed up at the hospital.
However, he didn't meet Yuan immediately. Instead, he spoke to the doctors about Yuan's condition to see if there were any concerns.
"Took you long enough," Yuan sighed when Supreme General Tian finally entered his room.
"What's with that attitude? Do you want me to come back later?" Supreme General Tian frowned.
"Go ahead. Just know that every day I spend trapped in this jail cell is another day I could be training and getting closer to defeating the Void Hunter.
After a moment of silence, Supreme General Tian said, "I spoke with the doctors, and they couldn't find anything wrong with your body."
"I told them multiple times that I was perfectly fine, but they refused to believe me."

"General Mei briefed me on your medical situation. As for these anomalies... I'm aware that several more are still afflicting you. So the next time you plan on treating one of them, let us know beforehand so we can properly prepare for whatever happens."
"I will."
"Anyway, let me bring you up to speed on our current situation..."
Supreme General Tian proceeded to explain everything Mei Feng had already told Yuan, but in far greater detail.

"Since the other cities realized they can't control you directly, they've sent large numbers of people to join our military in hopes of establishing a connection with you. So from now on, you should expect to be approached by quite a few people."
"What a pain in the ass... Fortunately, I'll be spending most of my time outside the city once I begin my training, so they won't have many opportunities to approach me."
Supreme General Tian narrowed his eyes slightly and asked, "Do you intend to go to the Level 2 Black Zone right after being discharged?"
Yuan nodded without the slightest bit of hesitation.
"That is my intention, so I hope you already have your investigators ready."
"They are."
"Then am I discharged?"
"You are." Supreme General Tian said after a long minute of silence.
"I'll be leaving tomorrow."
"Do you even know where to go?"
"Nope, but I'm sure you or someone else will tell me before I leave."
"Three days. You can leave in three days."
"I'm fine with that."
"Then meet up with the others at the western entrance at 0800, three days from now."
Supreme General Tian left shortly afterward.
After changing into his military uniform, Yuan also left the hospital.
And just as Yuan stepped outside the hospital, someone approached him.
"Are you Captain Yuan?"
Yuan turned his attention to the beautiful woman standing before him.
"You must be the new soldier, Li Jieyu. How can I help you?"
"I want to have a spar with you," she quickly answered.
Yuan raised an eyebrow.
"Why?" he asked a second later.

chapters.title: Chapter 2696 Li Jieyu
paragraphs: "I've just entered the military, and I'm already being compared to you... constantly," said Li Jieyu. "I don't like it."
"And? You want to spar with me and prove them wrong or something?"

"Are you kidding? I may be prideful, but I am not stupid. I know that I have no chance of defeating you in my current state. I want to see how big that disparity is so I know how much I need to improve to beat you."
"Is that so?" Yuan smiled. "Well, let me save you the time and some pain. You won't."
"I won't what?" Li Jieyu frowned.
"You won't ever catch up to me."
Li Jieyu narrowed her eyes at him, looking like she'd just found her archenemy.
"They weren't joking when they said you were arrogant. People always say my arrogance is second to none. They wouldn't be saying that if they'd met you."
"Or maybe you're scared? Because you heard that I'd nearly beaten all of your records during recruitment?"
Yuan shook his head and calmly replied, "I just don't like wasting my time, especially if I gain nothing out of it."
"Sounds like an excuse. You coward."
"What a cheap provocation. Did General Gu teach you that?" Yuan asked.
"General Gu? Why are you bringing him up?" Li Jieyu raised her eyebrows, looking puzzled.
"He didn't tell you? We have a complicated relationship. One that might get you in trouble."
"I don't care what beef you have with the Gu Family; it has nothing to do with me wanting to spar with you."
"If not General Gu, are you here on behalf of Ember City? Did they tell you to find evidence of me being a Void Specter?" Yuan then asked.

Although Supreme General Tian had warned him that General Gu had acquired a new talent, he never expected it would be her. Of course, he knew her name was Li Jieyu, but he didn't know her appearance until he watched the recording.
"That is none of your business," Li Jieyu responded coldly.

"Really? So you're telling me that your decision to leave your city and join another city's military had absolutely nothing to do with me? I find that hard to believe, especially when there are many others doing the same thing for this recruitment," Yuan said.
"Whether you believe me or not is none of my concern. I will ask you again. Will you spar with me or not?" Li Jieyu stared at him with a resolute face.
Yuan smiled and pointed at the building behind him.
"You realize that I was just discharged from the hospital, right? If you want to gauge my abilities properly, wait until I recover."
Li Jieyu fell silent, unable to dispute his logic. Even if she'd somehow managed to defeat him, it would mean nothing if he was injured.
"Then when do you want to do it?"
"Tomorrow. Meet me at the training hall tomorrow morning."
She nodded. "I will be there."
After that, Li Jieyu turned around and quickly left the scene.
News of Yuan's return quickly spread throughout the military like wildfire.
"Looks like that monster is still alive."
"I wonder what caused his hospitalization in the first place."
"If you're truly curious, you can go ahead and try asking him."
"I heard from someone who did ask him. Apparently, he was hospitalized because he was injured during training."
"What sort of training is he doing that resulted in several months of hospitalization?"
"The kind that prepares one to fight the Void Hunter, obviously."
The following day, Yuan made his way to the training hall. When he arrived, Li Jieyu was already waiting by the entrance, looking very eager to fight.
The atmosphere around her was so intense that others subconsciously walked around her as they passed, even if they were already far away from her.
The moment Li Jieyu noticed Yuan approaching the training center, she straightened her back and waited until he was close enough before speaking, "I wasn't expecting you to come.
"And why would you make such an assumption?" Yuan asked.
"Because I can."
Yuan merely shrugged at her response.
Shortly afterward, they headed into the training hall together and found an empty sparring room.
"To make things fair, I'll start by using only five percent of my strength so you can properly gauge the difference between us," Yuan said to her.
After all, if he fought her seriously from the get-go, she wouldn't even last a second.
"Five percent? Aren't you underestimating me a little too much?" Li Jieyu said with a frown.
"It's you who's underestimating me."
"Even though our cultivation is nearly the same?" Li Jieyu remarked, as she was at Second Level Sixth Ascension.
"I'm not going to waste my breath when you'll find out in just a moment," Yuan said before beckoning her. "Whenever you're ready."
In response, Li Jieyu retrieved her weapon—a sword.
"I hope you weren't expecting to fight barehanded," she said.
Yuan raised an eyebrow and asked, "You already have a weapon?"
"This is my personal weapon."
"You can use your personal weapon?"
"Of course. You think I snuck my weapon in here just to spar with you or something?"
"Kinda."
"Whatever. I'm starting."
After warning Yuan, Li Jieyu immediately made her first move, instantly closing the distance with Void Control before swinging her sword at him.
Yuan saw the attack from miles away and dodged it easily.
Li Jieyu was unfazed by her missed attack and immediately launched another, followed by yet another, unleashing a relentless barrage without giving Yuan a moment to rest.
Yuan couldn't help but smile, as her fighting style resembled Li Jinxi's during their first exchange on Earth.
"You have extraordinary strength and stamina, but you lack technique and strategy," Yuan remarked.
"Is this a spar or a lecture? I can't gauge anything like this! Fight back!" Li Jieyu shouted.
"As you wish..."
Now that he had a good understanding of Li Jieyu's level, Yuan fought back accordingly.
"This is ten percent of my powers."
Yuan struck with his bare arm.
It was an ordinary attack at a glance, but the moment Li Jieyu saw it, a chill ran down her spine, prompting her to dodge it.
"You have good instincts," Yuan said afterward.
Although his arm may appear empty, it was actually covered in Sword Aura and was no different than a sword.
Li Jieyu narrowed her eyes at his arm.
'He appears to be unarmed, but something about it feels off! What did he do?' she wondered inwardly.
Since she had no knowledge of Sword Aura, Li Jieyu couldn't comprehend the energy surrounding Yuan's arm. Still, she could sense something there... something dangerous.
"Here I come."
Yuan warned before charging at Li Jieyu, swinging his arm again when he got close enough.
This time, Li Jieyu didn't avoid it. Instead, she tried to block it with her sword.
Clang!
When her sword collided with Yuan's arm, an unexpected noise resounded.
Li Jieyu's eyes widened at the result.
'There really is something surrounding his arm!' she cried inwardly upon noticing that his arm wasn't actually touching her sword. Instead, a gap as thin as a sheet of paper separated them.
While she was distracted by the Sword Aura, Yuan made his next move, kicking her right in the stomach.
"Agh!"
Li Jieyu cried out loud as she was sent flying, but she quickly stabilized herself.
Despite the abdominal pain, Li Jieyu swiftly fought back.
"Fifteen percent."
As the fight prolonged, Yuan slowly increased the difficulty.
"Twenty percent."
By the time Yuan increased his strength to twenty percent, Li Jieyu could no longer defend herself and was forced to endure one attack after another.
"About twenty percent, huh?" Yuan muttered.
In reality, Li Jieyu could hardly handle Yuan even at ten percent of his true strength, but he kept on increasing it to see her limit.
"Well? What do you think? How long do you think it'll take you to catch up to me?" Yuan asked as Li Jieyu lay on the ground, gasping for air.
"Are you mocking me?" she growled.
Yuan replied with a smile, "If it'll motivate you to train harder, you can think of it that way."
"Join my squad," he suddenly added.
"Excuse me?"
"If you join my squad, I'll help with your training. Though it won't help you surpass me."
"Are you not worried that I might be a spy sent here to keep an eye on you?" she asked, looking dumbfounded.
"Even if you are, so what? It's not like you're the only one sent here to spy on me."
"That doesn't make any sense."
"Then let me put it in simpler terms—I just don't care."
After a moment of silence, Li Jieyu responded to his offer, "I'll think about it."
"Take your time. I'll be taking my leave now."
Yuan left the training hall shortly later and spent the next two days studying the final part of the Limitless Cultivation Technique.
And in the blink of an eye, it was time for him to leave the city and head to the Level 2 Black Zone.
Yuan arrived at the western entrance at exactly 0800. By the time he got there, a group of soldiers was already waiting.
"Why am I not surprised to see you here?" Yuan remarked as his gaze settled on the masked woman among them.
"Do you know how many soldiers are even qualified to enter such a dangerous place?" Ironwoman responded.
"Less than a hundred," she answered before he could respond.
"That's a lot more than I was expecting."
The Ironwoman shook her head at his response.
"Anyway, when can we leave?" Yuan then asked.
"Whenever you are ready."
"Then let's leave right away."

chapters.title: Chapter 2697 Level 2 Black Zone
paragraphs: At Yuan's command, they all left the city.
"I'll lead the way," Ironwoman said, taking the lead once they left the city walls.
Yuan quietly followed behind. Meanwhile, the other three soldiers followed behind him, staying a safe distance from him.
"Are they also part of the Supreme General's Midnight Squad? They wear the same outfit, but I didn't see them during the assembly." Yuan asked Ironwoman.
"They are. The Midnight Squad has several departments, each with their own specialty. This one specializes in surveillance, I guess," she responded.
"You guess?"
"I don't know everything, alright? Especially when it comes to the Midnight Squad."
"Then do you know how long it'll take us to reach our destination?"
"About a month and a half."
"I'll also be clearing out any Void Specters we encounter on the way," he said.
"That would slow us down significantly."
"Says who? I'll start doing it once we reach the Purple Zone, and it won't slow us down one bit."

Some time later, they entered the Purple Zone, and Yuan immediately began clearing out every Void Specter in their path. Of course, he did so without stopping even for a split second, letting the group keep moving forward without slowing down.
"Are you guys recording me?" Yuan asked the Midnight Squad out of curiosity.
"We are."
They admitted without hesitation.
"Is that so?" Yuan muttered, not surprised in the slightest.
After all, he had already been warned beforehand that they'd observe him in order to learn everything about him.
Time passed swiftly, and a little over a month later, Yuan and the others arrived at their destination.
"So this is the Level 2 Black Zone, huh?" Yuan muttered as they stopped at its border.

The atmosphere was drastically different from that of an ordinary Black Zone. Merely standing near it was enough to make one's skin crawl, and the suffocating pressure in the air gave the chilling sensation of standing at death's door.
Moreover, while the Black Zone was crawling with Void Specters, Yuan was unable to see a single one in the Level 2 Black Zone from where he was standing.
"We're here," Ironwoman said as she turned to Yuan.
"You'll be taking the lead from this point onward. And don't expect any of us—including me—to come to your aid if you find yourself in danger. We may be too busy trying to ensure our own survival."
Yuan nodded with a calm smile.
"I'd actually prefer it if you didn't risk your lives for me because it'd be a pointless sacrifice."
After saying that, Yuan entered the Level 2 Black Zone.
The Midnight Squad and Ironwoman followed behind, keeping enough distance to avoid getting caught up in anything Yuan encountered while remaining close enough to observe him clearly.

Of course, not everyone was focused on observing Yuan. Aside from Yuan himself, the group consisted of four people, only two of whom were tasked with monitoring him. The other two were responsible for keeping watch over their surroundings and protecting the observers, with Ironwoman taking on one of those roles.
Upon entering the area, Yuan immediately headed in the direction with the strongest fluctuations, which indicated the presence of Void Specters.

A few days later, Yuan finally encountered his first Void Specter. However, its appearance was unlike that of any Void Specter he had encountered before. Even so, it wasn't entirely unfamiliar to him.
'That looks like... a magical beast?' Yuan thought to himself.
Although its form was rough and distorted, Yuan could still make out the shape of a four-legged magical beast.

While Yuan observed it, the Void Specter suddenly noticed him and attacked without warning. In the very next instant, it condensed a dozen black bullets from its energy and fired them straight at him.
"Oh?"
Yuan calmly evaded the surprise attack, immediately noticing that its attack pattern was different from that of ordinary Void Specters, which typically attacked by extending parts of their bodies.
"So they can shoot their energy now, huh? That power was no joke, too.
Meanwhile, after seeing its initial attack missed, the Void Specter swiftly struck again. This time, it attacked with over a hundred black bullets at once.
Yuan used Void Manipulation to dodge the bullets before attacking the Void Specter with a black bullet of his own.
He only created a single bullet, but it had enough Eternal Essence to completely defeat an Elite Void Specter in the Black Zone in one hit.
Whoosh!

The black bullet tore through the air and struck the four-legged Void Specter squarely in the body. However, not only did it remain standing, but it also shrugged off the attack as though it were nothing more than a mosquito bite.
"Well then..." Yuan muttered with a raised eyebrow.
Although Yuan hadn't expected to defeat the Void Specter with a single attack, he also hadn't expected it to emerge completely unscathed. Its durability far exceeded his expectations.
The observers wondered whether it was still too early for Yuan to visit the Level 2 Black Zone and whether they should fall back for now.
However, just as those thoughts crossed their minds, the atmosphere around Yuan suddenly shifted, making him seem like an entirely different person.
Ironwoman's eyes widened. Even she had never seen him like this before.
"Now that I no longer have to hide my strength..."
A cold light flickered in Yuan's eyes as he extended a hand toward the Void Specter and made a grasping motion.

The next moment, three trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence descended upon the creature from every direction, compressing its entire body into a small sphere that closely resembled the black bullets it had used to attack Yuan.
The observers' jaws dropped at Yuan's sudden display of overwhelming power. More shockingly, none of them could even comprehend what kind of power he had just used.
"No way..." Ironwoman muttered in a daze.
Even she would need some time to defeat a Void Specter of that level. Yet, Yuan killed it with a single move.
'General Mei said that he'd used the system to treat some anomalies in his body, which caused him to be hospitalized... Is this power the result of that?' she wondered inwardly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2698 Level 2 Black Zone(2)
paragraphs: 'That was a bit of overkill. A trillion years' of Eternal Essence would've been more than enough,' Yuan thought to himself as he absorbed the Eternal Essence it left behind, which only took several seconds.
Once he was done, Yuan started moving again, chasing after his next target.
Seeing him leave without warning them, the observers snapped out of their daze and hurriedly chased after him.
A few minutes later, Yuan encountered another Void Specter. This time, it resembled a boar, but its body was absolutely massive, rivaling a small mountain in size.
However, a second later, two trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence descended upon the mountain-sized Void Specter, flattening it in the blink of an eye.
"Heavens! He defeated a Colossal-grade Void Specter with a single move! It didn't even get a chance to attack!"
"Has he always been this powerful?! I refuse to believe that he'd grown so much in such a short time span!"
"Where is his power even coming from? His cultivation is only at the Sixth Ascension!"
The observers were so shocked that they couldn't keep their voices down, despite having remained completely silent throughout the entire journey.
'Is that power from his original world?' Ironwoman wondered inwardly. His abilities seemed so otherworldly that she couldn't think of any other explanation.

Yuan continued defeating Void Specters one after another. Even after encountering more than a hundred of them, he had yet to see two with the exact same appearance. It was almost as though each one was unique in its own way. Some bore similarities to others, but none were ever completely identical.
After spending a few weeks in the Level 2 Black Zone, Yuan suddenly stopped hunting and turned to face the observers.
"I know I was only approved to enter the Level 2 Black Zone, but I overestimated this place. It's far too easy, so I was wondering if we could head to Level 3 instead?"
Although every observer had their face covered, their disbelief was still painfully obvious.
"It's not that simple," Ironwoman said, shaking her head.
"To enter the Level 3 Black Zone, you need to be accompanied by people who are qualified to go there, and none of us here meet that requirement."
"So it's too dangerous even for you, huh?" Yuan remarked.
"I'm not invincible, after all."
"How many people even meet that requirement, anyways?" he then asked.
"Less than five people..." she responded.
"That's... quite low."
"It is. In any case, if you want to go to Level 3, you'll have to go back and speak with General Mei."
"Alright."
With no other choice, Yuan returned to his training.

Although the Void Specters there yielded far more Eternal Essence than those in an ordinary Black Zone, they were also much more spread out, making them significantly longer to find. Because of this, Yuan wasn't actually gaining Eternal Essence much faster than in the Black Zone.
"I haven't seen any tunnels so far. Do they even exist in here?" Yuan suddenly asked.

"They do, but they're exceedingly rare," Ironwoman replied. "They're also extremely dangerous and difficult to clear. Even the ordinary Void Specters there can rival a Void Guardian from a regular Black Zone."
"Sounds like the perfect place for training..." Yuan remarked, hoping to find one soon.
However, eight months passed without Yuan encountering a single tunnel.
"Yuan, we need to start heading back," Ironwoman eventually said to him.
"We were only authorized to remain out here for a year at most. If we leave now, we'll be approaching that limit by the time we return."
"Okay."

chapters.title: Chapter 2699 Cafeteria
paragraphs: Yuan stood as still as a statue as he observed the scene, quickly realizing what was going on. Then, without the slightest hesitation, he turned around and walked away, having no desire to deal with any of the soldiers gathered there.
Since he couldn't go home, Yuan wondered if there was anything he could do to pass the time.
'Now that I think about it, I haven't really explored the military base,' he thought to himself.
Because Yuan spent far more time outside the city on missions than at the military base, he had never really had the chance to explore it properly.
Thus, he began wandering around the base.
However, there wasn't much to see. The area consisted mostly of roads and vast stretches of green grass, with only the occasional building scattered here and there.
There were plenty of soldiers wandering around, though. Since everyone's cultivation was restricted within the city, most people had no choice but to walk or run to their destinations.

Although vehicles and hovering boards were available, only officers were permitted to use them. Since the vast majority of personnel were ordinary soldiers, such forms of transportation were relatively uncommon.
"This must be the cafeteria..."
Some time later, Yuan arrived at the cafeteria. Upon seeing it, he realized that despite all the time he had spent in the military, he had never once gone inside to try the food.
Without hesitation, Yuan entered the cafeteria.
The interior was enormous and brightly lit, almost like a cathedral, with hundreds of tables of varying lengths neatly arranged throughout the spacious hall.
Even from the entrance, Yuan could see several serving stations, each offering a different selection of food.
"I should've visited this place sooner..." Yuan muttered.
He wasted no time and quickly lined up at the closest serving station.
It didn't take long for the soldiers inside to notice Yuan and recognize him.
"Hey, isn't that Captain Yuan? The one they've been calling 'Gaia's Hope'?"
"Gaia's Hope? Because he's the only one capable of defeating the Void Hunter?"
"Does anyone actually believe he has a chance to defeat the Void Hunter? Not even Tian Yuchen could defeat it!"
"Well, Tian Yuchen doesn't have the Perfected Heavenly Refinement, either."
"What even is the Perfected Heavenly Refinement capable of? We still know almost nothing about it—only that it can survive the Void Hunter's touch."
"I heard he's also immune to Void Specters."

While the soldiers chatted about Yuan, the man himself was busy stuffing his face with every dish from one serving station before moving on to the next, almost as if he were on a mission to eat everything in the cafeteria.
"My lord, what an appetite! I have never seen anyone eat so much before!
"He's eating like the cafeteria owes him money..."
Suddenly, a figure approached Yuan's table.
"May I have this seat?"
The individual asked, gesturing to the seat across from him.
Yuan lifted his head after hearing the familiar voice.
"We meet again, Huang Zhi Han," Yuan said after swallowing the food in his mouth. "You can sit there if you'd like."
Huang Zhi Han nodded and gracefully sat across from him.
"I told you we'd see each other again," Yuan continued with a smile.
"What's wrong?" Yuan asked when she didn't respond.
"You invited me to join your squad, right?" she suddenly asked.
"I did."
"Then why am I still not accepted into the squad? I applied the day I was asked to join, and I am still waiting for your approval a year later," she said with a frown.
"Oh... sorry, I was still in the hospital at that time, and when I came out, I left the city to train. I just got back, too. I'll approve your request right after this," Yuan apologized.
Huang Zhi Han sighed.
"And here I was thinking that woman had fooled me... You know, we nearly fought... several times, at that."
Yuan raised an eyebrow, looking surprised.
"By that woman... do you mean Mei Xiaoyun?"
"That's right. I'll have to apologize to her later..."
Yuan was left speechless.
"I'll talk to her, too," he said with a stiff smile.

After another moment of silence, Huang Zhi Han asked, "Do you mind if I ask why you invited me to join your squad? Surely, you're aware that many outsiders joined the military because of you. I'm one of them as well. Aren't you concerned about having me around?"
"Why would I be concerned about you? I trust you." Yuan calmly replied as he continued eating.
Huang Zhi Han raised her eyebrows in a puzzled manner.
"You trust me? Even though we've only met two times before this? And we're practically strangers? You're a little too trusting..."
"Only because it's you."
Huang Zhi Han's mouth dropped a little at his words that could easily be mistaken for flirting.
"I'll be honest with you. I am here because my father sent me to seduce you," she admitted after a brief hesitation.
"Is that so?" Yuan muttered, seemingly not surprised at all.
"And what does your father hope to achieve with that?"
"You should ask him that instead, because I have no clue."
"Well, are you going to seduce me then?"
"I'll think about it."
"Take your time."
Suddenly, Yuan heard someone shouting from the entrance.
"He's over there!"
Yuan tilted his head and looked past Huang Zhi Han toward the entrance, where dozens of soldiers were staring directly at him. One of them was even pointing in his direction.
Of course, these were the same soldiers who had been lingering outside his residence. They had clearly received word that Yuan was at the cafeteria, which explained their sudden appearance.
Once they spotted Yuan, the soldiers rushed to his table, surrounding him like an angry mob.
"H-Hello! I am—"
"My name is—! I came from—!"
The soldiers practically fought over one another just for the chance to introduce themselves.
Seeing this, Yuan frowned and raised his voice. "I don't care who you are or what you want from me, but if you keep disturbing my meal, you can forget about whatever you're planning."

chapters.title: Chapter 2700 Level 3 Black Zone
paragraphs: "Hey! What do you think you're all doing?!"
An officer approached the group of soldiers surrounding Yuan's table before any of them could respond, stomping toward them with a displeased expression on his stern-looking face.

"How dare a bunch of low-ranking soldiers interrupt an officer in the middle of his meal?! Did no one teach you proper military etiquette during boot camp, or did you all sleep through the entire thing?!"

Respect for rank was deeply ingrained in the military, especially when it came to lower-ranking soldiers showing deference to their superiors. What these soldiers were doing was not only disrespectful, but outright brazen.
"S-Sorry, Major Teng."
The soldiers quickly apologized after seeing his rank and name tag.
"Now get out of here before I write all of you up for disorderly conduct!"
Upon hearing that, the soldiers immediately turned toward the exit and ran away.
"Thank you," Yuan said to Major Teng a short while later.
Major Teng turned to look at him, still wearing a frown.

"I know you're still relatively new to the military despite already being a Captain, but you need to start acting like an officer and make sure the soldiers know their place, or they'll keep acting unruly."
Yuan nodded.
"I'll keep that in mind."
Without another word, Major Teng walked back to his table and continued eating his meal.
"What an uptight individual," Huang Zhi Han mumbled before looking at Yuan again.
"How much longer are you going to stay in the cafeteria?" she asked a moment later.

Yuan looked behind him and counted how many serving stations he had yet to visit, and replied, "I came here because those guys were lingering outside my house and I didn't want to deal with them, but now that they're gone, I can go back. With that being said, I'm going to stay here until I taste everything in here. It's not like I have anything better to do right now."
"Nothing better to do?" Huang Zhi Han raised an eyebrow. "What about training?"
"I just came back from training, and I need to receive approval before I can continue."
"Approval? Why do you need such a thing to train?"
"Because I am trying to visit the Level 3 Black Zone."
"L-Level 3 Black Zone?!" Huang Zhi Han exclaimed, her eyes widening in disbelief.
"What sort of training requires you to enter the second most dangerous place in the world?"
"If I am going to defeat the strongest being in the world, I have to do that much." Yuan shrugged.
"That makes sense..." Huang Zhi Han muttered at his reasoning.
"Anyway, if you're staying, I'll stay with you. Unlike you, I actually have nothing to do," she sighed a moment later.
Yuan didn't object and continued eating.
After seeing him eat so much, Huang Zhi Han also ended up grabbing a few plates of her own.
Some time later, they left the cafeteria together.
"I'll go accept your request now," Yuan said.
"I'll come with you."
As they walked, Huang Zhi Han reminded him, "By the way, you haven't really answered my question yet. Why did you invite me to your squad?"
"Do you believe in fate?" Yuan suddenly asked.
"Fate...? I'm not so sure about that."
"Well, I have a feeling that we're bound by fate."
"How do you feel something like that?"
"I just do."
Half an hour later, Yuan officially accepted Huang Zhi Han into his squad.
"We're only one member away from being officially recognized as a squad," Yuan said as they left the building.
"I'm surprised you don't already have four members, especially considering how popular you are."
"I only want people I can truly trust in my squad, and I already have a fourth in mind."
"Oh? Who?"
"Li Jieyu."
"Huh?" Huang Zhi Han's eyes widened.
"That woman? Do you know her?"
"No, not really.
She stared at him with a stupefied expression, clearly taken aback by his unexpected response.
"Don't tell me it's because you feel like the two of you are somehow bound by fate..."
Yuan didn't respond, merely smiling in silence.
"Unbelievable..."
Eventually, they arrived at Yuan's home.
"Are you going to follow me inside?" Yuan asked when they reached the doorstep.
Huang Zhi Han remained silent for a moment before shaking her head. "Maybe when we're more acquainted with each other."
"Then I'll see you later."
Meanwhile, somewhere in the base, Mei Feng and Supreme General Tian sat before each other with pondering expressions on their faces.
"No matter how many times I rewatch it, it still leaves me speechless..." Mei Feng sighed.
"I wasn't expecting him to be able to handle level two so easily," said Supreme General Tian.
"Do you think it has something to do with his anomalies?" he then asked.

"Either he has been hiding his strength this entire time, or he gained overwhelming strength after recovering from an unknown and powerful anomaly. If you ask me, the latter sounds more logical," said Mei Feng.
Supreme General Tian nodded.
"I agree."
"So what do you think? Allow him to enter level three?" Mei Feng then asked.
"Even in my Midnight Squad, only one individual has the qualifications to enter level three. However, I don't want to send him there as a mere observer. The risks are too high."
"Well, the only other people with qualifications to enter the Level 3 Black Zone are the Generals, and I highly doubt General Gu would be willing to do it."
"Are you implying that you want to go to the Level 3 Black Zone with him?" Supreme General Tian remarked while staring at Mei Feng with a raised eyebrow.
Before Mei Feng could even respond, Supreme General Tian spoke, "No, you can't. It's too risky."
"What other choices do we have? Don't tell me you are going to do it yourself?"
Supreme General Tian fell silent with a pondering look on his face.
"Are you really thinking about it?" Mei Feng asked, looking somewhat surprised.
